description:
We are hiring a full time video editor right now for ongoing podcast, YouTube, social media, and branded content projects.



We are looking for someone who can edit both long form and short form video, handle clean audio, color grade footage, and create polished content that is ready to publish. This is not a basic editing role. We need someone who understands pacing, story, audio quality, multi camera editing, captions, social media formatting, and professional delivery.



About Us



Organized Movements is a creative production and digital media company. We produce podcasts, branded content, social media videos, YouTube episodes, promotional videos, and client content for businesses, organizations, speakers, and creators.



We are growing and need a reliable full time editor who can join our team immediately.



Responsibilities



1. Edit long form podcast episodes, interviews, YouTube videos, and branded video content.



2. Edit short form reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and social media clips.



3. Create strong hooks, clean pacing, and engaging edits for short form content.



4. Handle multi camera switching for podcast and interview content.



5. Clean up audio, balance levels, reduce background noise when needed, and make voices sound clear and professional.



6. Color correct and color grade footage so the final video looks polished and consistent.



7. Add captions, titles, lower thirds, graphics, music, sound effects, and basic motion elements when needed.



8. Export videos in the correct formats for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, and client delivery.



9. Follow editing instructions carefully and meet deadlines.



10. Communicate clearly with our team and ask questions when something is unclear.



Required Skills



You must have experience with both long form and short form video editing.



You must have experience with multi camera editing and camera angle switching.



You must know how to clean and improve audio.



You must know how to color correct and color grade footage.



You must understand social media pacing, hooks, captions, and retention.



You must be able to follow detailed instructions.



You must be organized, dependable, and able to work full time.



Preferred Software Experience



DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Desktop, Descript, Adobe Audition, iZotope, or similar tools.

Can edit without needing every small detail explained.

Full time position.

Updating lead stages, call outcomes, tasks, reminders, and next steps in the CRM.

Following up leads consistently and professionally.

Reporting on daily activity, outcomes, blockers, and conversion issues.

Assisting with admin tasks when dialling work is complete or when directed.

Following up with insurers, superannuation funds, and related parties to help move client folders into an active stage within the business.



Performance Expectations

This is a performance-focused dialling role. Your KPIs will be based mainly on outbound dialling activity, follow-up consistency, CRM accuracy, and your ability to help move suitable leads forward.

You must be comfortable working with a CRM every day. We rely heavily on accurate notes, clean file management, task tracking, and clear communication between tea
mbers.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

Has excellent spoken and written English.

Is confident making outbound calls.

Is comfortable speaking with Australian clients.

Can sound natural, warm, and professional on the phone.

Is organised and reliable.

Can follow instructions carefully.

Is comfortable working with CRM systems, folders, files, and client records.

Takes detailed notes without needing to be reminded.

Can manage follow-ups without losing track of important tasks.

Has strong attention to detail.

Understands that sensitive client information must be handled carefully and professionally.

Experience in sales, appointment setting, claims support, insurance, legal intake, medical admin, customer service, or Australian campaigns will be highly regarded.



Why This Is A Great Opportunity

TPD Matters is a growing Australian business with a strong purpose. Our work helps people who are often going through difficult periods in their lives, and the right person in this role can make a real difference.

You will be joining a team that values clear communication, accountability, training, and long-term working relationships. This is not just a random calling job. You will learn our process, become part of the client journey, and play an important role in helping the business operate smoothly.

For the right person, this can become a stable long-term position with meaningful work, consistent expectations, and room to grow as the business grows.



How To Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only.

Your OnlineJobs.ph application must include:

Your latest resume.

A covering letter explaining why you believe you are perfect for this job.

A Loom video link answering the application question below in your own words.

If you skip any of the required items, your application will be marked as spam and you will not be contacted.

Application Question

Record a short Loom video answering this question:

Imagine you are calling a warm lead in Australia. They have enquired about help with a possible TPD claim, but they are unsure whether they want to continue and they are a little nervous about speaking with someone.

What would you say to them?



Please answer naturally, in your own words, as if you are speaking to a real client. Do not read from a script, do not copy anything from the internet, and do not use a template. We are using this Loom video to assess your English, your tone, and your ability to communicate clearly with someone who may be stressed or uncertain.

Remember: if your answer is not original, you will not be considered.

 subscribers and 20,

Position: Music Manager



We are looking for a music manager responsible for:

- Pitching proposals to songwriting job boards

- Keeping our books and managing contracts

- Driving success by boosting profits and hitting sales targets

- Leading and inspiring the team to deliver stellar performance

- Recruiting, hiring, and guiding contractors

- Managing operations, scheduling, and compliance

- Creating memorable customer experiences

- Onboarding and training new hires

- Communicating seamlessly with stakeholders

- Working 45-50 hours/week, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

- Lifting up to 25 pounds when needed



Disclaimer: Prospects will respond outside of scheduled hours. There will be an established 8-hour window where you’ll be expected to respond within an hour. Ex. Your schedule hours will be 6:30 PM -3:00 AM EST (From 3-11 PM EST if a prospect responds to a proposal, you’ll be expected to respond. Each response should take 5-15 mins. You can expect 3-5 responses per week. The additional hours may be deducted from your regular schedule if it exceeds 50 hours.



Contract Details

- Hourly Rate: $2.81/hr USD + 10%-15% of revenue

- Monthly Compensation: $505-$900 + commission

- Initial Hours: 10 hours/week, increasing to 45 hours/week over 45 days

- Training: Paid training provided

- Raises: Based on work performance



Hiring Process

This is an audition-based hiring process. We will select 3-5 candidates for a paid audition. After reviewing your work, we'll choose one full-time hire.

- Interview: To assess mutual fit

- Notification: Candidates will be contacted within 48 hours regarding audition status

- Video Chat: For day 1 of the audition



Responsibilities

Immediate Focus:

- Pitching to Songwriting Job Boards

- Album Launch Tasks

- Bookkeeping

- Onboarding & Interviewing Staff

- Explaining service and product prices

- Answering customer inquiries

- Obtaining customer information for shipping/services

- Managing our production team

- Communicating with tea
mbers/leaders

- Hitting monthly revenue goals



Future Responsibilities (If Qualified):

- Leading meetings

- Managing teams

- Reporting analytics

- Servicing customers



Skills and Qualifications

Essential:

- Persistence and determination

- Proposal writing skills

- Time management

- Product knowledge

- Customer service proficiency

- Strong English speaking/writing skills

- Reliable internet connection



Ideal Candidate Qualities

- Flexible and eager to learn

- High integrity and commitment

- Relentless execution

- Ability to work independently

- Competitive spirit

- Receptive to constructive criticism

- Effective communication skills



Benefits



Music Manager Incentive Program

The program motivates music managers to achieve monthly revenue goals, fostering a productive environment.



Eligibility: Current management team as of Jan 12, 2025

New hires must be with Pex Life Records for 6 months to qualify

Monthly Revenue Goals and Benefits:

- At $1,200 Minimum:

- Guaranteed Pay: $675 Minimum

- Commission: 10% on qualifying sales

- Additional Benefits: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement



- At $2,400 Minimum:

- Guaranteed Pay: $900 Minimum

- Commission: 15% on qualifying sales

- Additional Benefits: Social Security System Reimbursement, Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing

- Contractual Availability

- Flexible Scheduling: Choose your working days/hours

- Job Sharing: Train others to complete your tasks

- Revenue Lock-In Structure

- Contractual lock-in for pay based on hitting revenue goals over 2-12 months.

- Compensation

Monthly Salary: $505 USD (ifgoal isn't attained)

Start Date: 2 weeks after the interview (if selected)

Long-term Position: 32-40 hours/week

Available Hours: Sunday-Thursday 6:30 PM EST - 3:00 AM EST

Work Location: Remote



Only one position is available; apply now!

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,000
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Manager to manage and scale advertising campaigns across our Amazon brands. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of improving sales, lowering ACOS/TACOS, and driving profitable growth through data-driven advertising strategies.



Responsibilities

Manage and optimize Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP campaigns.

Conduct keyword research, bid optimization, and search term harvesting.

Monitor and improve ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.

Develop launch and ranking strategies for new products.

Analyze competitor advertising strategies and identify growth opportunities.

Create weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

Collaborate with listing, creative, and catalog teams to improve overall account performance.

Manage advertising budgets and ensure efficient spend allocation.

Requirements

Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC management experience.

Proven success managing multiple Amazon accounts and product categories.

Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Advertising Console.

Experience with tools such as Helium 10, Data Dive, Pacvue, Perpetua, Quartile, or Scale Insights.

Strong analytical and reporting skills.

Excellent communication and project management abilities.

Mandatory Application Requirements



To be considered, applicants must submit a portfolio/case study demonstrating previous Amazon PPC work, including:



Brands or categories managed

Monthly ad spend managed

ACOS/TACOS improvements achieved

Revenue growth results

Product launch success stories

Screenshots of campaign performance (sensitive information may be redacted)

Examples of PPC strategies implemented

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing supplement, health & wellness, or CPG brands.

Experience with Amazon DSP.

Experience launching new products and scaling established brands.

Knowledge of Amazon SEO and listing optimization.

title: AI Image Specialist
description:
Urgent Hiring: AI IMAGE SPECIALIST

Reports To: Creative Asset Manager

Work Hours: 40 hours weekly - Flexible Time



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



This is an AI-first role.



We are not looking for a traditional graphic designer who occasionally uses AI. We are looking for someone who actively uses AI image generation and editing tools as a core part of their creative process and is passionate about staying ahead of emerging AI technologies.



Candidates should be prepared to share examples of AI-generated work, discuss their preferred AI tools and workflows, and demonstrate how they use AI to increase creative output and efficiency.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, and people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of graphic design and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our AI Image Specialist.



Role Purpose

This role is responsible for designing creative and compelling visuals for new and existing products, including illustrations, packaging, and listing images primarily through AI-powered workflows. You will also create diverse marketing materials such as social media graphics and website elements, as needed.



THIS IS AN AI-FIRST ROLE.



Primary Objectives

Deliver high-quality, on-brand designs for listings and marketing materials.

Lead AI-powered image creation and continuously improve visual production through emerging AI tools and workflows.

Collaborate with product and marketing teams to align designs with objectives.

Optimize product images to meet e-commerce guidelines and boost performance.



Regular Work Activities

Research, test, and implement new AI image generation and editing tools.

Develop effective product visuals, including listing graphics, packaging & instructions aligned with brand identity and target audience using AI workflows.

Collaborate with the product development and marketing team to ensure designs are aligned with product specifications and marketing objectives.

Create high-performing e-commerce listing images that meet platform guidelines and brand standards.

Edit and enhance product photography to support marketing and marketplace needs.

Perform color correction, background removal, image resizing, and other necessary edits to create polished and professional images.



Key Skills

Expert-level proficiency with AI image generation platforms.

Expertise in graphic design, illustration, and digital content creation

Strong understanding of brand identity and e-commerce platform requirements

Always updating AI knowledge to best use new software, and processes

Proficient in design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, etc.)

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Excellent photo editing skills (color correction, background removal, resizing)

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

Knowledge of current design trends and techniques

Self-starter who raises issues and proposes solutions before asked – a critical thinker who finds mistakes and corrects them



People Contacts and Interactions

Marketing Team – Collaborate on design concepts, campaign strategies, and promotional materials.

Amazon Operations Team – Ensure product listings and images meet Amazon’s platform guidelines and optimize performance.

Creative Asset Manager – Submit designs for review and finalize images for approval and publishing.



Role Requirements

3+ years of experience in graphic design or visual content creation

Proven experience designing for e-commerce platforms (Amazon, Shopify, etc.)

Daily user of AI image generation tools such as Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, Magnific, Photoshop AI, or similar platforms

Proven history of learning and implementing new AI tools independently.

Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in product visuals and marketing collateral

Excellent communication and teamwork skills

Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

A degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field (preferred)

title: Sage Intacct Migration Consultant (Contract / Project-Based) CPA Required
description:
About Firm Five



Firm Five is a fast-growing, CPA-led accounting and controllership firm serving clients across Canada and the United States.



We are currently supporting several private equity-backed and multi-entity organizations that are migrating from QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online to Sage Intacct and are looking for an experienced consultant to support these projects.



Contract Type:

Part-time

Project-based

Remote

Flexible hours

Ongoing opportunities for the right person





The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Sage Intacct consultant who has successfully completed QuickBooks-to-Intacct migrations and implementations.

This role will support our accounting and controller teams on client migration projects, particularly for multi-entity organizations with complex reporting requirements.



Responsibilities:

Lead or support Sage Intacct implementations

Design multi-entity structures within Sage Intacct

Build charts of accounts and dimensional reporting frameworks

Migrate historical data from QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online

Validate imported transactions and opening balances

Reconcile migrated financial data

Assist with testing and go-live activities

Provide best-practice recommendations for Sage Intacct setup

Support Firm Five controllers during implementation projects





Required Experience:

• Demonstrated Sage Intacct implementation experience

• Multiple completed QuickBooks ? Sage Intacct migrations

• Strong understanding of:

Multi-entity accounting

Consolidations

Intercompany transactions

Dimensions and reporting structures

Financial statement design



• Advanced Excel skills

• Strong English communication



Highly Preferred:

Previous experience working for a Sage Intacct implementation partner

CPA, CMA, or equivalent accounting designation

Private equity or portfolio-company experience

multi-location business experience

Ideal Candidate

You have personally completed Sage Intacct migrations before and can confidently guide a client from QuickBooks to a fully functioning Sage Intacct environment.

We’re not looking for someone who has simply used Sage Intacct—we’re looking for someone who has implemented it.



To Apply Please send:

Resume

Hourly rate (USD)

Number of Sage Intacct implementations completed

Number of QuickBooks ? Sage Intacct migrations completed

Largest multi-entity organization you’ve migrated

Brief summary of your role on those projects

title: SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST | ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS
description:
SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners is a growing vacation rental management platform supporting multiple local hospitality brands across Texas, New Mexico, and California. We manage high-quality vacation homes with a focus on strong homeowner partnerships, thoughtful guest experiences, local market expertise, and disciplined operational execution.



As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized marketing function that supports all of our markets, improves the performance of our listings, strengthens our homeowner acquisition efforts, and helps us present a consistent, premium brand across every channel.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and creative Senior Marketing & Channel Specialist to support marketing across our vacation rental portfolio.



This role will report to our Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with our market teams, revenue management, onboarding, field operations, and external marketing partners.



This is a hands-on marketing role focused on listing optimization, channel content quality, website updates, homeowner acquisition marketing, referral channel support, brand consistency, and select social media support. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, comfortable with digital tools, highly organized, and excited to help build scalable marketing processes for a growing hospitality business.



This role is especially important because our listings, websites, homeowner-facing content, and referral channels directly impact our ability to grow revenue, attract new homeowners, and create a premium brand experience across every market.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



LISTING OPTIMIZATION & CHANNEL CONTENT

* Own the quality, consistency, and optimization of property listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, Google Vacation Rentals, direct booking websites, and other distribution channels.

* Write and refine listing titles, descriptions, summaries, photo captions, amenity highlights, and market-specific content.

* Review listings for completeness, accuracy, conversion quality, and brand consistency.

* Help determine the best hero images, photo order, captions, and property highlights for each listing.

* Coordinate with market teams to confirm property details, amenities, local recommendations, and unique selling points.

* Manage the listing optimization checklist for new and existing homes.

* Support the launch of new listings by ensuring marketing content is complete, accurate, and on-brand before going live.

* Review underperforming listings and recommend content, photo, or positioning improvements.

* Manage the relationship with photography partners to help ensure property photography is high quality, consistent, and aligned with our brand standards.

* Coordinate photography needs, shot lists, photo feedback, and follow-up requests with market teams and external photographers.



WEBSITE & DIRECT BOOKING SUPPORT

* Maintain and update property pages, market pages, owner-facing pages, and other website content.

* Ensure direct booking websites are accurate, polished, and aligned with current listings and brand standards.

* Support the creation of landing pages for market-specific campaigns, homeowner acquisition, and referral partners.

* Help improve website content for SEO, readability, and conversion.

* Coordinate with website vendors or internal tea
mbers when technical changes are needed.

* Support updates to Google Business Profiles and other local search assets.



HOMEOWNER ACQUISITION MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts designed to attract new vacation rental homeowners.

* Help create and maintain homeowner-facing materials, including one-pagers, brochures, market summaries, case studies, listing improvement examples, and sales support materials.

* Support
 campaigns, nurture sequences, and other marketing efforts for prospective homeowners.

* Help package the EHP value proposition clearly across markets, including our approach to home care, revenue management, guest experience, and owner communication.

* Create market-specific content that helps homeowners understand why our local teams are the right partner for their vacation rental.



REFERRAL CHANNEL MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts for referral partners, including real estate agents, brokers, developers, designers, contractors, and other local professionals who may refer homeowners to us.

* Help create referral partner collateral, outreach materials,
 campaigns, and follow-up content.

* Maintain referral channel marketing assets and ensure they are professional, clear, and easy for partners to share.

* Support the marketing side of our lifetime value of leads strategy, helping us stay visible and valuable to referral sources over time.

* Coordinate with leadership and market teams to identify partner opportunities and create simple, repeatable campaigns.



BRAND & CONTENT CONSISTENCY

* Help maintain consistent brand voice, tone, and visual standards across all markets and channels.

* Create and manage templates for listings, owner marketing, referral partners, social media, presentations, and website content.

* Use tools like Canva and Google Workspace to produce clean, professional, on-brand marketing materials.

* Ensure each local brand feels personal and market-specific while still reflecting the quality and standards of Elevated Hospitality Partners.



REPORTING & PROCESS MANAGEMENT

* Maintain a marketing tracker for listing optimization, website updates, referral marketing, owner acquisition campaigns, and active projects.

* Provide regular updates to the Chief Commercial Officer on progress, priorities, and blockers.

* Track key marketing activity, including listings optimized, new listings launched, website pages updated, referral materials created, and campaigns supported.

* Help build repeatable marketing processes as we scale across markets.

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across our marketing work.



SOCIAL MEDIA

* Support social media content across our brands, with a primary focus on homeowner brand awareness and homeowner acquisition rather than guest marketing.

* Create and maintain a simple content calendar focused on brand credibility, homeowner education, market presence, property highlights, team stories, and referral partner visibility.

* Repurpose listing content, market insights, owner-facing content, and local stories into social media posts.

* Create professional, on-brand graphics and short-form content using Canva or similar tools.

* Ensure social media supports the broader business goal of building trust with homeowners and referral partners.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Listings are polished, accurate, compelling, and consistent across channels.

* New homes are launched with complete and high-quality marketing content.

* Website and direct booking content stays current and professional.

* Homeowner acquisition materials are organized, clear, and easy for the sales team to use.

* Referral partner marketing is consistent and professional.

* Photography partners receive clear direction and deliver brand-aligned property photos.

* Marketing projects are tracked, prioritized, and completed on time.

* The company has stronger marketing systems that can scale across multiple markets.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

* Excellent written English and strong editing skills.

* Experience in digital marketing, hospitality marketing, vacation rental marketing, real estate marketing, or a similar field.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage many listings, projects, and deadlines.

* Experience writing marketing copy for websites, listings,
s, or social media.

* Comfort working with digital platforms, website builders, channel tools, spreadsheets, and project trackers.

* Strong Canva or basic graphic design skills.

* Good understanding of brand consistency and premium presentation.

* Ability to work independently, ask smart questions, and organize work clearly.

* A proactive, problem-solving mindset.

* Interest in hospitality, travel, real estate, and vacation rentals.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:

* Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or Google Vacation Rentals

* Guesty or another property management system

* Vacation rental or short-term rental marketing

* Real estate or property management marketing

* Website CMS tools

* Google Business Profile

* Google Analytics

* Meta Business Suite

*
 marketing tools

* SEO basics

* Photography coordination or creative direction



TOOLS YOU MAY USE

* Guesty

* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* Google Vacation Rentals

* Google Workspace

* Canva

* Meta Business Suite

* Google Business Profile

* Website builder tools

* Project management or tracking tools

* AI writing and productivity tools



COMPENSATION

* Full-time remote role based in the Philippines

* Compensation: $1,200-$1,500 USD per month, depending on experience

* 13th month pay

* Full-time schedule

* 90-day performance and compensation review

* Long-term growth opportunity as our marketing function expands



WORKING HOURS

• This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time.

• Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.

• 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT.

• Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

• Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.





APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To apply, please submit the following:



1. RESUME OR WORK HISTORY

Please share your resume, LinkedIn profile, or a short summary of your relevant work experience.



2. MARKETING PORTFOLIO OR EXAMPLES

Please include examples of marketing work you have created or managed. This could include:



* Vacation rental listings

* Airbnb, Vrbo, or 
 listing copy

* Website pages

* Real estate or hospitality marketing materials

* Social media content

*
 campaigns

* Brochures, one-pagers, or Canva designs

* Before-and-after examples of listings or marketing content you improved



We are especially interested in examples related to short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, real estate, travel, or local service businesses.



3. VACATION RENTAL / OTA EXPERIENCE



Please briefly answer the following:

* Have you worked with Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, Google Vacation Rentals, Guesty, or other vacation rental platforms?

* Have you optimized vacation rental listings before? If yes, what changes did you make?

* What do you look for when trying to improve the performance of a vacation rental listing?

* What process or checklist do you use to make sure a listing is complete, accurate, and attractive to guests?

* How do you think about the differences between Airbnb, Vrbo, direct booking websites, and other OTAs?



4. LISTING OPTIMIZATION CASE STUDY

Please review the following Airbnb listing: 



After reviewing the listing, please provide a concise recommendation for how you would improve it.



Your response should include:

* A brief summary of your overall impression of the listing.

* An optimized listing title. Please provide one title you believe would perform well on Airbnb and briefly explain why.

* A rewritten and optimized version of the listing. Please rewrite the full listing copy, including the main description, property/space details, location information, guest access, and any important notes you believe should be included. The listing should be written to clearly present the property, highlight its most compelling features, and drive conversion to booking.

* Your top 5 recommended improvements. These can relate to copy, photo order, amenities, guest expectations, OTA performance, direct booking potential, or anything else you believe would improve the listing.

* Your approach to listing optimization. Briefly explain the process you would normally use when reviewing and improving a vacation rental listing.



Please keep your response practical and concise. We are looking for clear writing, strong judgment, and an understanding of how to improve vacation rental listing performance.



WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to join a growing hospitality business at an early stage and help build the marketing engine for a multi-market vacation rental platform. You will have the chance to make a direct impact on listing performance, homeowner acquisition, referral partner marketing, and brand growth across several unique vacation rental markets.



We are looking for someone who is thoughtful, organized, creative, and excited to help build something that can scale.

title: Guest Experience Specialist, Third Coast Elevated Stays
description:
Third Coast Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving the Texas coast markets of Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island. We are focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes the Texas coast special - its people, coastal culture, beach communities, and local character - while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.?



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist - Texas Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Third Coast, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Central Time (CDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after-hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am CDT) is handled by a separate rotation.



Central Daylight Time (CDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm CDT ? 8pm–4am PHT

• 11am–7pm CDT ? 12am–8am PHT

• 3pm–11pm CDT ? 4am–12pm PHT

• 11pm–7am CDT ? 12pm–8pm PHT



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $800 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly 5-Star Bonus: $50 if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 60%+.

• PTO: Accrues at 1 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines. 



Role and Responsibilities



Elevated Guest Engagement (Guesty + text/email)

• Answer guest messages (text,
, OTA inbox via Guesty) with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

• Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/roads, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

• Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

• Ensure every guest experience feels special and elevated



Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

• Place a welcome phone call to every guest prior to arrival day and send a personalized welcome text

• Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

• Identify opportunities to make the guest’s stay an elevated and memorable experience



Phone support (RingCentral)

• Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

• Troubleshoot common issues (access, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics) and escalate when needed



Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

• Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

• Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

• Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless



Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

• Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

• Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm CDT the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

• Maintain accurate property notes and updates

• Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context



Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

• Guest messages answered within 15 minutes during your shift (text,
, Guesty inbox)

• Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

• No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

• Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Property Listing Management & OTA Updates

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, and other OTAs.

• Update photos, amenities, room configurations, access notes, and seasonal details as needed.

• Ensure descriptions reflect the true guest experience with clear, warm, and helpful language.

• Flag inconsistencies, outdated information, or missing details to the Manager for correction.

• Support seasonal updates (spring break, summer beach season, hurricane season, local events, and holiday periods) to elevate guest expectations and reduce pre-arrival questions.

• Ensure every listing reflects our Elevated Promises — clarity, care, and a welcoming tone.



Local expertise

• Become an expert on Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island, including seasonal rhythms, beach conditions, weather impacts, and local norms.

• Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, beach activities, family experiences, fishing and boating options, and local attractions in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that elevate each stay.

• Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, and any “good to know” details for guests.

• Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including relevant local
 groups).

• Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

• Excellent written and spoken English and a warm, helpful tone

• Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

• Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on weekends and busy days

• Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

• Comfortable learning and working inside Guesty, Breezeway, and RingCentral

• Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply



Please submit the following:

• Resume/CV

• 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

• Speedtest.net result (screenshot)



Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

• “The hot tub isn’t heating. Can you help?”

• “Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?”

• “We’re staying in Port Aransas — any recommendations for a great breakfast spot for our family?”



Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

• “We can’t get into the home, the code isn’t working.”

• “The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work.”

• “Can we check out one hour later?”

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Accounting Operations Lead | Elevated Hospitality Partners
description:
ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS | ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS LEAD



Philippines - Independent Contractor | Full-Time



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners supports a growing portfolio of short-term rental property management brands across multiple U.S. markets, including Texas, New Mexico, and California, with over 1,000 total properties.



Our companies manage vacation rental homes on behalf of homeowners, with a focus on excellent guest experiences, thoughtful homeowner communication, strong local operations, and disciplined financial management. As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized finance and accounting function that can support our operating companies with consistency, accuracy, and scalability.



We are looking for an experienced Accounting Operations Lead based in the Philippines to help manage our end-to-end accounting workflows across all markets.



This is not a basic bookkeeping role. We are looking for a high-ownership accounting professional who has existing experience in the U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting space and understands the complexity of homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, vendor payments, tax filing and remittance, property-level accounting, and month-end close across multiple markets.



IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT

- Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business is required.

- Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred, but not required. Experience with similar property management systems or short-term rental accounting workflows will also be considered.

- CPA certification is preferred.



ROLE OVERVIEW

As the Accounting Operations Lead, you will report to the Chief Financial Officer and be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations across our three short-term rental brands.



You will lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources. Initially, much of the work will involve managing external bookkeeping and accounting partners, ensuring their work is completed accurately and on time, and taking day-to-day accounting coordination off the CFO’s plate. Over time, this role may help build, train, and lead internal accounting tea
mbers as we bring more accounting processes in-house.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple accounting workstreams at once. You should be able to create structure, identify gaps, follow up on open items, and ensure accounting processes are completed accurately and on time.



WORKING HOURS

This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time. Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.



Central Daylight Time to Philippines Time:

* 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT

* Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

* Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This is a full-time independent contractor role based in the Philippines.

* Base pay: $1,700-$2,300 USD per month, based on experience.

* Compensation at the higher end of the range will be reserved for candidates with direct U.S. short-term rental accounting experience, Guesty experience, homeowner statement and payout experience, CPA certification, and prior leadership of bookkeeping or accounting resources.

* 13th month pay: Offered in December and prorated for partial years.

* PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month, usable after 90 days, with no annual rollover.

* Long-term opportunity: This is intended to be a long-term role with the opportunity to grow into a broader accounting leadership position as we continue building our internal finance and accounting team.



YOU WILL OWN

* Day-to-day accounting operations across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Month-end close coordination across all operating brands.

* Chart of accounts maintenance and accounting structure improvements.

* Homeowner statement review and homeowner payout support.

* Vendor payment workflows and accounts payable coordination.

* Tax filing and remittance support.

* End-to-end accounting flows across property management systems, accounting platforms, banking/payment tools, and reporting processes.

* Coordination and accountability of external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Accounting SOPs, checklists, calendars, and process documentation.



ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES



ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

* Manage day-to-day accounting workflows across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Coordinate accounting activities across multiple markets, brands, entities, and accounting resources.

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule.

* Maintain clear accounting task lists, close calendars, open-item trackers, and follow-up routines.

* Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve accounting workflows.

* Create structure and accountability across the full accounting process.



MONTH-END CLOSE

* Own and coordinate the month-end close process across all operating brands.

* Maintain the monthly close calendar and ensure deadlines are met.

* Review reconciliations, open items, supporting schedules, and accounting workpapers.

* Coordinate with bookkeeping and accounting resources to resolve missing information or discrepancies.

* Prepare summaries of close status, unresolved issues, and items requiring CFO review.

* Support timely preparation of market-level and company-level financial reporting.

* Help ensure each market’s financials are accurate, consistent, and ready for leadership review.



CHART OF ACCOUNTS AND FINANCIAL STRUCTURE

* Help maintain and improve the chart of accounts across multiple entities and operating brands.

* Ensure transactions are coded consistently across markets.

* Support department, market, homeowner, property, and entity-level reporting needs.

* Help create scalable accounting structures that support business growth.

* Document accounting policies, workflows, coding rules, and reporting standards.

* Identify where account structure, classes, departments, properties, or other reporting dimensions need to be improved.



HOMEOWNER STATEMENTS AND PAYOUTS

* Support the preparation, review, and accuracy of homeowner statements.

* Help ensure homeowner payouts are processed accurately and on time.

* Review homeowner charges, owner proceeds, adjustments, deductions, reimbursements, and management fees.

* Investigate and resolve homeowner accounting questions or discrepancies.

* Ensure property-level revenue, expenses, fees, and reimbursements are properly reflected.

* Help maintain clean and accurate homeowner accounting records.



VENDOR PAYMENTS AND PAYABLES

* Manage and improve the vendor payment process.

* Ensure vendor bills are properly received, coded, approved, and scheduled for payment.

* Coordinate with market teams to resolve missing invoices, approvals, W-9s, or supporting details.

* Support payment tracking, vendor statement review, and payables reporting.

* Help ensure strong controls around vendor payments and expense approvals.

* Identify recurring vendor payment issues and recommend process improvements.



TAX FILING AND REMITTANCE SUPPORT

* Support lodging tax, sales tax, occupancy tax, and other required tax filing and remittance processes.

* Track filing deadlines and payment due dates by market.

* Coordinate with internal and external resources to ensure filings are prepared and submitted on time.

* Reconcile tax liability accounts and investigate discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting records for tax filings, payments, and related schedules.

* Help ensure tax processes are documented, repeatable, and scalable across markets.



END-TO-END ACCOUNTING FLOWS

* Manage accounting workflows across systems such as property management software, accounting platforms, payment tools, bank accounts, and reporting tools.

* Support the flow of reservation revenue, guest payments, owner payouts, management fees, vendor charges, taxes, reimbursements, and company revenue.

* Help reconcile data between property management systems, banking/payment platforms, and accounting software.

* Identify broken workflows, missing data, duplicate entries, reconciliation issues, and process gaps.

* Create and maintain SOPs for key accounting processes.



SYSTEMS AND TOOLS

* Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software is required.

* Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred.

* Experience with short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting systems is highly valuable.

* Experience with tools such as Topkey, Breezeway, AppFolio, Buildium, Hostaway, Streamline, Track, OwnerRez, or similar platforms is a plus.

* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are required.



TEAM AND RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

* Lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources.

* Assign tasks, follow up on progress, and hold resources accountable to deadlines.

* Review work quality and escalate issues when needed.

* Help train future accounting tea
mbers as the internal team grows.

* Build SOPs, checklists, and process documentation to support future scalability.

* Help create a high-quality internal accounting function over time.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

* 5+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, finance operations, or related experience.

* Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business.

* Experience with homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, property-level accounting, trust/escrow-style workflows, or similar accounting processes.

* Experience with U.S. accounting practices and working with U.S.-based companies.

* Strong QuickBooks Online experience or experience with similar accounting platforms.

* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

* Experience managing month-end close tasks and reconciliations.

* Experience coordinating with bookkeepers, accountants, operators, or business leaders.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Ability to work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time.



STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

* CPA certification.

* Guesty experience.

* Experience with short-term rental or vacation rental homeowner statements.

* Experience with homeowner payouts and homeowner accounting.

* Experience with lodging tax, occupancy tax, sales tax, or similar tax remittance processes.

* Experience with multi-entity businesses.

* Experience supporting multiple markets, locations, or operating companies.

* Experience building accounting SOPs and process documentation.

* Experience leading or supervising bookkeepers or accounting assistants.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership.

* Strong follow-up and accountability.

* Able to manage multiple deadlines and workstreams.

* Comfortable working with U.S.-based leadership teams.

* Able to identify accounting issues and recommend solutions.

* Process-minded and interested in building scalable systems.

* Clear, professional, and responsive in communication.

* Comfortable leading other accounting resources.

* Excited to grow with a company over time.



LOCATION

This role is fully remote within the Philippines. Candidates must have reliable internet, a quiet professional work environment, and the ability to work overnight Philippines hours aligned to U.S. Central Time.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit the following:

* Resume/CV.

* Brief written summary of your accounting experience.

* Details of your experience with U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting.

* Any experience you have with Guesty or similar property management systems.

* Any experience you have with homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, trust/escrow-style accounting, lodging tax, or month-end close.

* Your experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting systems.

* Your experience managing bookkeepers, accounting assistants, or external accounting resources.

* Your expected monthly compensation in USD.

* Your availability to work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time.

* Speedtest.net result screenshot.



REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Describe your experience with U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting.



2. Have you worked with Guesty? If yes, what accounting-related tasks did you handle inside or connected to Guesty?



3. Have you prepared or reviewed homeowner or owner statements? Please explain.



4. Have you supported homeowner payouts, lodging tax, sales tax, occupancy tax, or trust/escrow-style accounting?



5. What accounting software have you used? Please describe your QuickBooks Online experience.



6. Tell us about a time you managed bookkeepers, accounting assistants, or external accounting resources.



7. Describe your month-end close experience.



8. Are you a CPA? If yes, please include details.



9. What is your expected monthly compensation in USD?



10. Can you consistently work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time?



Applications that do not describe relevant short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting experience will not be considered.

title: Junior Ecommerce Product Specialist (Shopify) – Product Import, Editing & Cleanup
description:
About the Role

We run a growing portfolio of Shopify ecommerce stores and are looking for a Junior Ecommerce Product Specialist to handle the hands-on work of getting products into our stores and making the product pages clean, accurate, and launch-ready. You’ll import products from AliExpress using DSers, clean up the images and details, and organize everything so our stores ship faster.

You don’t need years of experience — if you know your way around Shopify and you’re a fast, careful learner, we’ll teach you our exact import, editing, and cleanup process. What matters most is reliability and attention to detail.

This is steady, ongoing work with real room to grow as we launch more stores.



What You’ll Do

• Import products from AliExpress into Shopify using DSers — we’ll train you on our exact workflow.

• Clean and edit product images — background cleanup, consistent sizing, a professional look across the catalog.

• Write and tidy up product titles and descriptions so they read well and match our brand standard.

• Check and fix product pricing, variants, and “sibling” product groupings.

• Assign products to the correct collections and categories.

• Catch and fix product data issues — missing prices, wrong info, duplicates, mismatched entries.

• Apply a quality standard set by our store builder, consistently across many products per store.

• Keep your tasks updated in our tracking system so progress is visible to the team.



What We’re Looking For

• Shopify experience is required — you’re comfortable in the admin with products, collections, and variants.

• Genuinely detail-oriented — you notice the off price, the wrong collection, the image that doesn’t match.

• A fast, willing learner — happy to be taught a process and then run with it.

• Reliable and consistent — you hit deadlines and communicate clearly about your progress.

• Good written English — enough to write clean, readable product descriptions.

• Basic photo editing comfort (Canva, Photoshop, or similar) — or eager to learn quickly.



Nice to Have (not required)

• Experience with DSers or other AliExpress import tools.

• Experience with larger product catalogs (100+ products).

• Familiarity with dropshipping and cleaning up messy imported product data.



Why Work With Us

• Steady, long-term work — we’re launching new stores regularly, so the work doesn’t run out.

• Real training and clear systems — you won’t be left guessing.

• Room to grow as we scale.



How to Apply

To show you actually read this post, start your application with the word “SHOELACE” so I know you’re detail-oriented. Then include:

• A short intro about your Shopify experience and what you’ve done with it.

• Any product editing or import work you’ve done (examples or before/after images are a big plus).

• Whether you’ve used DSers or done AliExpress imports before (totally fine if not).

• Your expected monthly salary and your available hours.

Applications without the code word will not be reviewed.

We are a plaintiff-side personal injury law firm based beside Seattle, Washington, USA - in the heart of the Pacific Northwest tech corridor near Microsoft, Amazon, and Boeing. Our practice focuses on traumatic brain injury, some of the most intellectually demanding and high-stakes litigation in US civil law. We are searching for a brilliant new or recent law graduate who genuinely loves legal research and writing and wants to build a career doing it at the highest level.



This is NOT a typical VA or paralegal role. You will not be practicing US or Washington law, and you are not expected to know any of it yet. You will be our litigation research-and-writing engine. Your work product - motions, briefs, discovery responses - is reviewed and signed by our Washington attorneys.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Draft and respond to motions, supported by rigorous legal research.

• Assist with discovery: answering interrogatories and requests for production, and crafting precise objections.

• Produce well-organized, persuasive, court-ready legal writing under attorney supervision.

• Grow into a deep working knowledge of US and Washington law and civil procedure.



WHAT WE OFFER



• Salary of USD $1,800 to $2,500 per month, based on credentials and experience.

• A clear annual raise structure tied to performance.

• 13th month pay, as guaranteed under Philippine law.

• HMO / health insurance coverage.

• Paid leave (vacation and sick leave).

• Full access to the same premier legal research databases that US attorneys use.

• We supply you with all needed hardware, software, subscriptions, and legal research databases. You supply a fast and reliable internet connection.

• Hands-on mentorship and training in US and Washington law - we will teach you everything.

• A genuine long-term career path with increasing responsibility.

• The option to work remotely or from a professional office in IT Park, Cebu once that space opens.



HOW YOU WILL BE EMPLOYED (IMPORTANT)



You will be formally employed through a licensed Employer of Record (EOR) in the Philippines. This means you are a properly employed worker - not an unprotected freelancer. The EOR handles all payroll, government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), 13th month pay, and statutory benefits in full compliance with Philippine labor law. You get the stability and legal protections of formal employment while working for a US firm.  



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• A new or relatively recent law graduate. Top of your class, law journal, moot court, or bar honors strongly preferred.

• Someone who LOVES legal research and writing - this is the core of the job, every single day.

• Exceptional written English and analytical reasoning, on par with a US law-review graduate.

• Intellectual curiosity, precision, and the drive to produce work that needs no corrections.

• No prior knowledge of US or Washington law required. Just the talent and the hunger to learn it fast.



WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL



You will work on brain injury cases where excellent research and writing genuinely change lives. We hold a high bar: our goal is for your work to be so strong it can be filed in Washington courts exactly as written, signed by the attorney whose name goes on the pleading. If you take pride in being the sharpest writer in the room, you will fit right in. 



HOW TO APPLY



1. Your resume.

2. Your law school class rank or honors (and bar status, if applicable).

3. A short writing sample - a brief, memo, or essay you are proud of.

4. A few sentences telling us why legal research and writing is the work you want to do.



Applications without a writing sample will not be considered. We read every thoughtful application carefully.
