title: Short-Form Video Editor — Bulk Batch Project (40 Reels, Repeatable) ($250–$400 per batch)
description:
# Short-Form Video Editor — Bulk Batch Project (40 Reels, Repeatable) ($250–$400 per batch)



**Job Type:** Project-based / Gig (batch work, repeatable)

**Budget:** $250–$400 per 40-video batch (based on experience)

**Skills:** Video Editing · CapCut · Short Form Video

*
 applications to:** 

**Company:** Chic Kitty / Shaggy Chic — a pet lifestyle media company



---



 About this project



We're a pet lifestyle media company with a steady supply of raw footage and user-submitted clips (cats and dogs) that need to be turned into short-form vertical Reels.  This is **batch work: one defined batch of 40 finished Reels at a time.** Deliver that batch **on time, fully to spec, with excellence, and we'll keep sending more 40-video batches.** This can be ongoing for the right editor — but each batch is committed and judged on its own.



## The deliverable



- **Exactly 40 finished short-form Reels per batch**, edited from raw footage and approved user-submitted clips we provide via Google Drive

- Pick the strongest 
nts and cut them into tight, scroll-stopping vertical videos

- Apply clean, on-brand pacing and a cool-toned color grade (we provide exact specs)

- Deliver files namedaccording  to our convention, organized in our Drive folder

- **Repeat batches are offered only when a batch is delivered on time, fully to spec, and at a high quality bar.** Miss the deadline, miss the specs, or deliver sloppy work, and the engagement ends at that batch.



## Production standards (these are firm)



- **Format:** 9:16 vertical, 1080×1920 MP4

- **Length:** Reels **10–20 seconds** (never under 10 —
 requires a 
-second minimum for a Reel to stay monetization-eligible).  Aim for the 10–15-second range, which wins reach while clearing the
 floor; only go longer when the clip genuinely holds attention (if a clip is flagged for TikTok, 15–30 seconds is fine). Never stretch a clip that's strong at 12 seconds.

- **Hook:** the strongest, most surprising 
nt in the first 1–3 seconds of every video

- **Color grade:** cool-toned required. Warm or golden grades are an automatic no

- **Loop:** end frame should flow cleanly back to the opening frame

- **No burned-in text** — text is added later by our team

- **No watermarks** of any kind, from any app

- **Audio:** deliver silent, or with audio on a separate strippable layer — our posting team adds trending audio natively at posting time

- **100% human editing.** No AI-generated footage or subject. This is a hard rule, and we screen for it.



## Logistics



- Batch work, remote, **firm deadline per batch** (we'll set it with you up front based on the footage)

- Viewer access to footage via our secure Drive

- Paid per batch via PayPal or Remitly on approved delivery

- Reports to the Operations Manager for handoff and review



## To apply



1.  Share 2–3 short-form vertical videos you've edited (links)

2   Confirm you can work to the specs above (10–20s, 1–3 sec hook, cool grade, no watermark, no burned text, silent delivery)

  . Tell us your realistic turnaround for a batch of 40 short videos



**Paid sample:** finalists will edit **one** Reel from our footage as a paid sample ($15, paid whether or not we proceed) before we assign the first full batch. This protects both of us.



We read every application. Generic or AI-written responses won't move forward.

title: Job Title: Operations Coordinator / Team Lead (High Accountability / SLA Enforcer)
description:
Job Overview



We are looking for a fierce, highly organized, and results-driven **Operations Coordinator / Team Lead** to oversee our global team. This is not a passive monitoring role. You will be the engine that drives our daily operations forward, managing cold callers in Egypt/Latin America, processors in America, and our Account Executives.



If you are uncomfortable delivering tough feedback, holding people accountable to tight deadlines, or terminating underperforming tea
mbers, **this role is not for you.**



We have all the plug-and-play systems, scorecards, and tracking data completely built out. You don’t need to reinvent the wheel—you just need to enforce it. You provide the backbone, discipline, and execution to ensure our Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met every single day.



---



 **Key Responsibilities**



* **Team & Process Management:** Oversee and manage a diverse international team, including cold callers (Egypt/LATAM), processing teams (USA), and Loan Officers.

* **Ruthless Accountability:** Monitor daily scorecards and data. Call out missed targets immediately. Provide hard, constructive critiques and do not hesitate to terminate individuals who consistently fail to meet standards.

* **SLA Enforcement:** Ensure all tea
mbers are hitting their required metrics and moving tasks forward without delays based on our data tracking.

* **Account Executive Oversight:** Manage our Account Executives to ensure they are actively recruiting, onboarding, and following up with agents daily.

* **Admin & Payroll:** Manage team scheduling, track attendance/timing, and handle the administrative side of payroll processing.

* **Training & Recruitment:** Learn every facet of our operations inside and out so you can personally train new hires and assist in the recruitment pipeline.



---



### **What We Provide**



* **Built-Out Systems:** Complete tracking frameworks and scorecards. You will know exactly who is performing and who isn't based on our numbers.

* **Clear KPIs:** No guesswork. Your job is simply to act on our data, praise the winners, and address the underperformers.



---



### **Required Qualifications & Traits**



* **Management Experience:** At least 1–3 years of experience managing multiple processes or teams, preferably in real estate, mortgage, or call center environments.

* **Thick Skin & Strong Backbone:** You must be comfortable with confrontation, managing remote teams, and delivering difficult feedback firmly but professionally.

* **Detail-Oriented & Tech-Savvy:** Able to look at a scorecard, instantly spot where the bottleneck is, and take immediate action to fix it.

* **Flawless Communication:** Exceptional written and spoken English. You must be able to confidently manage diverse cultures across the US, Latin America, and Egypt.

* **High Urgency:** You don’t wait for things to happen; you push them forward. You are proactive and obsessed with efficiency.



---



### **Working Hours & Compensation**



* **Shift:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST)

* **Salary:** $640 USD / month

* **Job Type:** Full-time



---



### **How to Apply**



To apply, please reply with the subject line: **"I Am Your Next Operations Coordinator"** and include:



1. A brief summary of your management experience (specifically handling remote callers or processors).

2. An example of a time you had to deliver difficult feedback or fire someone, and exactly how you handled it.

3. Your updated resume and OnlineJobs.ph profile link.



> *Applications that do not follow these instructions or omit the required subject line will be automatically disqualified.*

title: Master Cold Caller
description:
B2B Cold Caller — Outbound Sales VA (US Business Hours)

Electi Delivery Services · Remote / Full-Time

Full-Time

Remote

Outbound Sales

B2B Cold Calling

US Business Hours

About the company



Electi Delivery Services is a same-day B2B courier and logistics company based in Phoenix, Arizona. We move time-sensitive freight for healthcare clinics, auto dealerships, law firms, freight forwarders, and logistics companies. We're growing fast and need a cold calling VA who can open doors and generate qualified leads from decision-makers — not gatekeepers.



What you'll be doing

Making
outbound cold calls per day to US businesses in our target verticals, Calls are only about 1-3 mins each

Following a proven script and conversation flow to qualify decision-makers and book appointments

Handling objections confidently and pivoting naturally — not reading robotically from a script

Logging all call activity, outcomes, and notes in our outreach tracker (Google Sheets / Excel)

Flagging warm leads and hot prospects to ownership immediately for follow-up

Sending follow-up
s or texts after calls when directed

Attending a brief daily check-in with the team to review call performance and pipeline

Target industries you'll be calling

Healthcare — medical clinics, home health agencies, physical therapy offices, pharmacies

Auto dealerships — service departments, parts managers, general managers

Law firms — office managers, legal administrators

Freight forwarders and third-party logistics companies

Requirements

These are hard requirements. If you do not meet all of them, please do not apply.

Minimum 2 years of outbound cold calling experience — BPO call center background strongly preferred

Neutral or near-neutral American English accent — clear, confident, and professional on the phone

Experience selling to US businesses (B2B), not consumers

Proven ability to handle objections, gatekeepers, and difficult decision-makers

Stable internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps), reliable power, and a quiet work environment

Own headset and computer — no mobile-only applicants

Available to work Arizona / Mountain Standard Time business hours (MST, no daylight saving)

Comfortable using Google Sheets, Excel, and CRM or outreach tracking tools

What we're really looking for



We've hired VAs before. We know the difference between someone who can read a script and someone who can actually sell. We want the latter. You need to be able to hold a natural conversation, think on your feet when a prospect pushes back, and stay motivated through a high volume of dials without losing your energy or your professionalism.



If you've worked in a BPO selling services to US businesses, you know exactly what this role requires. That's our benchmark.



Who this is not for

Do not apply if you have only done customer service, data entry, or chat support. Do not apply if you have a heavy accent that affects call clarity, cannot work US business hours, or need a script read verbatim because you can't handle live objections. We will know within the first 30 seconds of a mock call.

Compensation

Competitive base rate commensurate with experience — state your rate expectation in your application

Performance bonuses available for qualified leads that convert to clients

Paid weekly

Long-term position for the right person — this is not a one-month contract there will be bonuses on top of salary pay



To be considered, you must complete all steps below. Missing any step = automatic disqualification.



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

How to apply (follow all steps)

Send your resume with a summary of your cold calling and BPO experience

Record a 60–90 second voice introduction — tell us who you are, your experience, and why you're the right fit. Upload to Google Drive or Dropbox and include the link.

Record a 2-minute mock cold call using this scenario: You are calling a Phoenix auto dealership and asking to speak with the service manager about same-day parts delivery. Handle at least one objection.

Answer the following screening questions in your message:

Screening questions

How many years of outbound cold calling experience do you have, and was it B2B or B2C?

Have you worked in a BPO call center? If yes, what product or service were you selling?

What CRM or outreach tracking tools have you used?

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar.



If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly:



- Google Maps Listing: 

- Instagram: 



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that:



"Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?"



No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human.



We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path.



The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not.



If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here.



If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



- Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken.

- Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.)

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between July 13 – July 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself

title: Founder's Associate, Operations & Systems (Startup Gaming Niche)
description:
**About us**



We're a small, fast-moving team in the video game industry. We're growing quickly, we treat our people well, and we play the long game: clear expectations, steady work, genuine respect, and real growth for those who earn it. This is a seat to build a career in, not a churn-and-burn gig. We're looking for someone exceptional to grow with us.



**What this role is**



You'll be the right hand to seasoned founders who move fast and never run out of ideas, which is exactly why this role exists. Your job is to bring order to that: take things off the plate, build the systems that keep the business running, and turn loose goals into finished work.



Sometimes you'll have a clear process to follow. Just as often, you won't, and that's where the right person shines. When there's no playbook, you research it, figure out the smartest way to do it, talk it through with the founders, build the process, and then act on it.



A real example of what we mean:



"We need to bring on a video editor. Figure out where to find good ones, what it should cost, screen the candidates, bring me your top picks, and once we approve, get them onboarded and working."



That's the level of ownership we're after. We want to hand you a goal and trust it's handled, not assign you a checklist. If you bring problems wrapped in solutions instead of just questions, you'll thrive here. 



If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this isn't the fit.



We'll have a short check-in call once a day during the initial period to stay aligned, get you up to speed on how we work, unblock you quickly, and move quickly together.



 **What you'll do**



It varies week to week, but expect a mix of:



- Building SOPs and systems: Turning the things we do into clean, written, repeatable processes so the business runs more smoothly over time. This is a core part of the job, not an afterthought.  

- Acting on those systems: Running and following up on recurring work so nothing slips, and keeping our internal systems tidy and up to date.  

- Project management: Owning one-off projects end-to-end: scoping them, driving them, and reporting back clearly.  

- Hiring support: Sourcing, screening, and helping onboard contractors and tea
mbers as we grow.  

- Content posting: Publishing and organizing content across our channels on a consistent schedule.  

- Coordination: Working with vendors, contractors, and our team to keep things moving.  

- Research: Figuring out the best way to do something we've never done, then bringing back a clear recommendation.



The specific tools and tasks are learnable, and we'll teach you what's specific to us. What we can't teach is the resourcefulness and drive to own the outcome.



**Who you are**



- Resourceful: When you hit something you don't know, you figure it out. You research, you learn, and you come back with a plan, not just a question.  

- Proactive and ownership-driven: You anticipate what's needed, follow through without reminders, and treat the business as if it were your own.  

- Organized and systems-minded: You think in processes and checklists. You like building order out of chaos and enjoy finding smarter ways to do things.  

- Comfortable with ambiguity: A sharp, fast learner who can take a vague goal and find the path forward.  

- An excellent communicator: in written and spoken English, clear, professional, and easy to work with. You'll talk to the founders directly and represent us with vendors and contractors.  

- Hungry, with high standards and a strong work ethic: This matters to us more than your résumé. You take pride in your work, and you don't cut corners.  

- Honest, discreet, and trustworthy: You'll handle sensitive information.



**Nice to have**



These are bonuses, not requirements. Tell us if you have any of them:



- 2+ years supporting founders, executives, or businesses  

- Fluent with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. We love people who use them to move faster  

- Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, Trello, or similar  

- Experience writing SOPs or documenting processes  

- Hiring or recruiting experience  

- Content creation or light video editing



**The details**



- Hours: Full-time, with some daily overlap with British Summer Time. We'll work out the exact hours together.  

- Pay: 40,000 PHP  

- Payment: Weekly or biweekly via PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, or similar.  

- Location: Fully remote, work from home.  

- Type: Long-term. We want someone to build a future with us, and strong performers grow quickly from here.



**How to apply**



Please don't send copy-pasted applications. We read every complete one, and generic ones get ignored. One step:



Record a short Loom or YouTube video (a few minutes, on your own time) telling us:  



   - A quick introduction about yourself and your relevant experience  

   - Do you have any experience with video games? If so, which games do you play?  

   - A time you were handed something with little or no instruction, and you figured it out and got it done  

   - Why this role excites you and what makes you the person we're looking for



We reply to every application that's a fit. We're excited to meet you.

Attention to detail is critical, as you will be expected to identify discrepancies and resolve them efficiently. Familiarity with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms is important, as well as comfort working with spreadsheets and digital financial tools.

title: App and Website Development Leader
description:
APP & WEBSITE DEVELOPER



Position Title: App & Website Developer



Reports To: Ownership and Senior Leadership



Position Type: Independent Contractor



Overview



We are seeking an App & Website Developer to support the design, development, maintenance, and ongoing improvement of digital platforms across a growing portfolio of businesses and projects.



The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining websites, mobile applications, customer-facing digital tools, internal management systems, and other technology solutions that enhance the experience of customers, staff, and stakeholders.



This role is ideal for a self-motivated developer who enjoys working independently, solving complex problems, and helping build innovative digital solutions.



Primary Responsibilities



• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain websites and web-based platforms. • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms. • Create and maintain internal management systems, dashboards, databases, and digital workflows. • Integrate third-party software, APIs, payment processors, CRM platforms, communication tools, and other business systems. • Improve website performance, functionality, user experience, and accessibility. • Troubleshoot technical issues and implement solutions in a timely manner. • Monitor website and application security and implement best practices to protect organizational data. • Maintain hosting environments, domains, SSL certificates, and related infrastructure. • Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiencies. • Develop digital tools that support registrations, memberships, bookings, customer management, reporting, and operational processes. • Create and maintain technical documentation for developed systems and applications. • Assist with implementation of future technology initiatives as required.



Additional Responsibilities



• Provide recommendations regarding technology strategy and digital infrastructure. • Research and evaluate emerging technologies and software solutions. • Support digital marketing initiatives where appropriate. • Participate in project planning meetings and provide development timelines and estimates. • Ensure all systems comply with applicable privacy, security, and accessibility requirements.



Qualifications



• Demonstrated experience in website and mobile application development. • Proficiency in modern programming languages and development frameworks. • Experience with front-end and back-end development. • Experience working with databases and cloud-based infrastructure. • Experience integrating third-party APIs and software platforms. • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices. • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. • Strong communication and problem-solving skills. • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience developing customer-facing applications and digital platforms. • Experience with booking, scheduling, or membership systems. • Experience with payment processing integrations. • Experience with CRM and business management platforms. • Experience with AI tools, automation platforms, and workflow systems. • Experience developing applications for both Apple App Store and Google Play Store distribution.



Performance Expectations



The App & Website Developer will be expected to:



• Deliver projects within agreed-upon timelines. • Maintain reliable and secure digital systems. • Respond promptly to technical issues affecting operations. • Provide ongoing improvements to digital platforms and infrastructure. • Maintain professional communication with leadership and stakeholders. • Support the long-term growth and technology objectives of the organization.



Ownership of Work Product



Unless otherwise agreed in writing, all websites, applications, source code, designs, databases, content, documentation, intellectual property, and other work products created during the course of the engagement shall become the exclusive property of the organization upon payment for services rendered.



Confidentiality



The Developer shall maintain strict confidentiality regarding all organizational, financial, operational, customer, contractor, employee, and business information obtained during the course of their engagement.



Independent Contractor Status



This position is intended to be an independent contractor relationship. Nothing in this position description shall be construed as creating an employment relationship between the Developer and the organization.



Location



Remote, hybrid, or on-site arrangements may be considered based on project requirements.



Compensation



Compensation shall be established through a separate Contractor Agreement and may be based on hourly, project-based, retainer, or milestone-based compensation structures.

title: Personal Assistant (PA/EA) / Bookkeeping Assistant — UK Accountancy Practice
description:
Hi, I'm Fiona.



I run a small UK accountancy practice that has grown faster than I expected. I love serving clients and doing the work — and now I'm looking for one exceptional person to help me keep the practice organised, moving, and under control.



This is not a basic admin role. It's not a bookkeeping-only role. And it's not a role for someone who waits to be told every tiny step.



I'm looking for a brilliant PA / Client Admin Assistant who can also support some basic bookkeeping. You'll help with
s, diary, client follow-ups, onboarding, social media admin, client communication, practice admin, and light bookkeeping.



The most important part isn't advanced accounting. It's being organised, reliable, clear, and proactive — and helping me stay on top of things.





YOU, IN A NUTSHELL

------------------------------

• You get things done, and you don't wait around for perfect instructions.

• You're highly organised and calm under pressure.

• You have excellent written and spoken English, and you communicate clearly.

• You notice what needs doing and follow it through.

• You enjoy making messy things tidy.

• You're reliable, trustworthy, and professional.

• You take ownership of your work.

• You make life easier, not harder.





THE KIND OF PERSON I REALLY NEED

-----------------------------------------------------

You don't need to know everything already. But you do need to know how to find things out.



When you hit something you've not done before, I need someone who has a sensible go at working it out — checking a help page, searching properly, looking at a previous example, or using an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude to think it through — then has a careful attempt and flags anything they're not sure of.



I'm glad if you use AI to get yourself unstuck — it's how good people work now. What I don't want is someone who goes quiet, guesses blindly, or waits for every answer to be handed to them.



>> I don't need someone who knows everything. I need someone who knows how to find out.



(One small thing that isn't in the form's list of questions: somewhere in your voice message, please also tell me what the temperature is where you are right now.)





THE BOOKKEEPING SIDE, HONESTLY

----------------------------------------------------

It's light to start with — mostly posting invoices into Xero and keeping records tidy. You don't need years of bookkeeping behind you, and you don't need to be an expert.



What I need is the common sense to have a go, think it through, and ask a good question when something's genuinely unclear. I'd far rather have someone who thinks clearly and flags a sensible question than someone who guesses and makes a mess.



The bookkeeping will grow over time, with support from self-learning and your team — so there's room to learn built into the role.



(And while we're talking ledgers: when you reach the application form, type the word ledger into box 7.)





WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH

----------------------------------------------

A small, personal team — me (Fiona), my husband Rudi, who looks after systems and tech behind the scenes, and our senior accountant in the Philippines. We work from home. It's personal, hands-on, and real.



You'll be PA to me, but your day-to-day will run mostly through Rudi — systems,
s, onboarding, admin and process work — with bookkeeping guided by either myself, Rudi or eventually our senior accountant.



The point of this role is to protect my time, keep work moving, and make sure important things don't get missed. You won't be just a number here — we're a small team, and we care about the people who work with us.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

-------------------------

• Help manage my
s and diary

• Communicate with clients to get information in and keep work on track

• Track follow-ups and chase missing records, answers, documents and approvals

• Help with client onboarding

• Draft
 replies and client messages

• Keep client records, folders and checklists tidy

• Help move work in the door, through the process, and out the door

• Support social media admin and post scheduling

• Support general practice admin and help document repeat processes

• Post invoices into Xero and support basic bookkeeping tasks

• Take written instructions and voice notes and turn them into clear action

• Spot problems early and flag them clearly

• And anything else really that we need help with when it's needed



This isn't an advisory role — you won't give accounting or tax advice to clients. But it is a communication-heavy PA role, so you'll need to be confident, clear, professional and comfortable dealing with clients to get things sorted.





MUST-HAVES

-------------------

• Strong PA, admin, operations or client-support experience

• Experience supporting a business owner directly

• Experience working remotely for a UK business, UK clients, or similar overseas clients

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong attention to detail and very strong organisation

• Good spreadsheet skills, and confidence with
, online systems and shared folders (Gmail, Google Drive)

• Some hands-on exposure to bookkeeping and/or Xero — you don't need to be experienced, but you should have actually used them. Xero certification would be a huge bonus.

• Able to follow written and verbal instructions properly, and comfortable turning voice notes into action

• Able to use initiative, work things out sensibly, and ask good questions when stuck

• Able to take ownership without needing constant chasing

• Reliable, trustworthy and professional

• A modern laptop or PC, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work





HELPFUL, BUT NOT ESSENTIAL

--------------------------------------------

• Experience in a UK bookkeeping or accountancy practice

• Experience with client onboarding or chasing client information

• Experience with social media admin or post scheduling



You do need to be switched on, organised, confident, and able to think.





HOW WE'LL ASSESS YOU

-----------------------------------

This is a serious role, so we'll assess properly. We'll be looking at your written and spoken English, your clarity of communication, your ability to follow instructions, your organisation and attention to detail, your ability to think and work things out, and your ability to take ownership and follow through.



Please only apply if you're confident in those areas.





PAY & CONTRACTOR TERMS

---------------------------------------

• Pay is Php60,000 per month

• This is an independent contractor role, not employment

• Paid monthly in PHP — you handle your own taxes and contributions in the Philippines

• Bring-your-own-device: we don't provide hardware initially

• Full contractor terms will be set out clearly before work begins





HOURS

-----------

Full-time, based around UK time. We don't expect silly hours, but we need reliable overlap each weekday for communication, handovers and keeping work moving — typically 8:00am–12:00 noon UK time, which means late afternoon/evening in the Philippines depending on the time of year.



We don't use invasive screen-tracking software. We manage by trust, communication and output.





WHY THIS MIGHT BE THE PLACE FOR YOU

-----------------------------------------------------------

I built this business so I could be there for my daughters. Family matters to me, trust matters to me, and doing good work properly matters to me — and I want the right person in this role to have that same dignity: to work from home, be trusted, do meaningful work, and grow with a small team that values good people.



We're not for everyone. But if you're organised, reliable, switched on, and looking for a serious long-term role with a small UK firm, this could be a very good fit.





HOW TO APPLY

----------------------

Apply through our application page: 



Access code: FJ2026



The application has a few short questions and a short voice recording.



Please complete it carefully. Short, rushed applications won't be considered — I'm looking for someone thoughtful, organised and serious.



Learn more:

description:
# AI Creative Strategist & E-Commerce Visual Designer



**Remote (Philippines) · Part-Time, 30 hrs/week · $1,500–$2,500 USD/month (DOE)**



*Exceptional candidates with proven Amazon, AI creative, and e-commerce results may be offered above this range.*



## The role in one sentence



You'll use cutting-edge AI tools to turn customer insights into product visuals and video that measurably increase conversion across Amazon, Shopify, and social — for a premium beverage brand sold in the world's leading hotels, spas, and cruise lines.



This is **not** a traditional graphic design job. We don't need someone to execute briefs. We need someone who studies a product, reads the reviews, sizes up competitors, and shows up with a point of view about what should change and why.



## Who you are



You blend six skill sets that usually live in different people:



- **E-commerce merchandiser** — you know how a gallery sells

- **Creative strategist** — you find the angle others miss

- **AI creator** — you produce faster and better with modern tools

- **Product storyteller** — you turn a feature into a feeling

- **Photo & video editor** — you can actually build the assets

- **Conversion-focused marketer** — you care about the number, not just the look



You move on your own. You spot opportunities and propose them before being asked. And you're genuinely excited that AI lets you test more creative ideas, faster, than traditional workflows ever allowed.



## What you'll do



**Amazon (primary focus)**

Build high-converting image galleries, infographics, comparison charts, and feature callouts. Upgrade A+ Content. Mine competitor listings for openings we're not using.



**Shopify & website**

Design banners, promotional assets, collection graphics, and stronger product-page imagery. Support new product launches.



**AI-powered content**

Generate lifestyle imagery and product concepts, enhance existing photography, and build AI-assisted product demos. Keep experimenting as the tools evolve.



**Short-form video**

Edit for Amazon, Shopify, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn — captions, motion graphics, product callouts, and educational content.



**Creative strategy (the part that matters most)**

Read reviews, study competitor listings, and identify the pain points and purchase drivers behind each product. Then translate those insights into specific image and video concepts.



> *Example: if reviewers keep saying a tea helps them wind down at night, you flag that insight and propose imagery and video built around a calming evening ritual.*



## What success looks like



The person we hire asks questions like:



- "Why aren't we highlighting this benefit customers keep mentioning?"

- "Reviews bring this up constantly — shouldn't it be image #2?"

- "Could we stage a luxury-hospitality lifestyle scene around this product?"

- "I found three angles competitors aren't using."



Beautiful content is the baseline. The goal is visual assets that lift engagement and conversion, strengthen the brand, and make Art of Tea the most visually compelling name in specialty tea and hospitality.



## Your first 90 days



**Days 1–30** — Learn our products and brand standards. Audit Amazon and Shopify creative. Review customer reviews and competitor listings. Present prioritized recommendations.



**Days 31–60** — Upgrade priority image galleries, ship new infographics and AI-generated lifestyle imagery, launch first video assets, and start building repeatable workflows.



**Days 61–90** — Complete priority catalog upgrades, establish AI-powered creative systems, recommend ongoing tests, and operate independently as both designer and strategist.



## Requirements



- 3+ years in graphic design, e-commerce design, or creative production

- Strong Photoshop and video editing skills

- A portfolio of product-focused creative work

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Sharp attention to detail and the ability to work independently

- Reliable high-speed internet



## Nice to have



Amazon listing experience · Shopify experience · AI image generation · AI video generation · direct-response or conversion-optimization experience.



## Tools we use (or want you exploring)



Photoshop, Premiere, Canva Pro, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Flux, Runway, Kling, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, Claude. You don't need all of them — but you should be the kind of person who tries the new one the week it launches.



## How to apply



Send us:



1. Resume and portfolio

2. Sample Amazon listing images

3. Sample product photo edits

4. Sample video editing work

5. Sample AI-generated content (if you have it)



**Then complete this short exercise** — it's how we identify the people who actually think like this role demands. Pick any product on the Art of Tea website and give us:



- The top 5 customer benefits

- 3 image callouts you'd create

- 3 lifestyle image concepts

- 3 video concepts

- Which AI tools you'd use, and why



We read every submission to this question first. Make it count.

***International EA experience is required (working for U.S. or international client as their EA). Please DO NOT apply if you don't have this experience.



***Instructions on how to highlight which specific experience you have is shown at bottom.







The role:

An early-stage edge-AI startup automating the gate and yard operations of the global container logistics industry. As the CEO scales the company's go-to-market efforts, his calendar, inbox, and inbound pipeline are growing fast — and he needs a sharp, reliable Executive Assistant to keep all of it organized.



This is a true executive assistant role, not a sales role. Your job is to protect the CEO's time, keep his agenda conflict-free, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Because the company is in an active outbound and inbound growth phase, the role will start with core EA work and expand into sales-adjacent support as the campaign matures, so comfort with ambiguity and a willingness to grow into new tools is essential.







What you'll do:

- Own the CEO's calendar end to end: schedule and coordinate meetings, prevent conflicts, manage rescheduling, and keep the daily agenda clean and current.

- Coordinate appointments across multiple time zones and counterparts (U.S., Europe, Middle East, Latin America).

- Manage and triage inbound
; draft, send, and track follow-ups on the CEO's behalf.

- Field and organize inbound responses from prospects coming through LinkedIn, the company website, and
.

- Keep follow-ups, action items, and commitments tracked and nothing forgotten.

- Prepare for meetings: gather context, assemble materials, and confirm logistics.

- Provide general administrative organization that keeps the CEO moving quickly.





How the role grows:

The scope expands in phases as the GTM campaign progresses:



1. **Foundation** —
 and calendar management, scheduling, and follow-ups.

2. **Inbound triage** — Light CRM hygiene and structured handling of inbound interest as volume increases.

3. **Sales-ops support** — Hands-on help with the outreach stack (e.g., Sales Navigator, Smartlead) as the pipeline scales.



You won't be expected to do all of this on day one, but you should be eager to take on more over time.



What we're looking for:

- Proven experience as an executive assistant.

- Excellent English communication, written and spoken, this is the core requirement.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through; you catch conflicts before they happen.

- Comfortable owning a busy executive's calendar and inbox with minimal oversight.

- Fluency with Gmail,
-response workflows, and Google Calendar (including delegated access).

- Comfortable managing inbound outreach from LinkedIn and a company website.

- High discretion and sound judgment handling confidential business communications.

- Self-directed, responsive, and reliable during full Pacific business hours.



Nice to have:

- Ability to communicate in multiple languages, especially in Spanish (written) ; English remains the core need, and translation tools can support as needed.

- Exposure to B2B sales operations, CRM tools, or outbound tooling (Sales Navigator, Smartlead, or similar).

- Experience supporting a startup founder or fast-moving small team.

- Familiarity with logistics, supply chain, or technology businesses.









Details:

-Work from home

-$5/hour

-40 hours/week

-Mon-Fri U.S. time

-9am-5pm Pacific Mon-Fri (12am-8am Philippines time, midnight Tues-Sat).

-Long term, room for growth within organization











HOW TO APPLY:

1. Please send an
 with your resume attached and a brief overview of your relevant experience in the body of the
 to 
 with the subject line “Bernardo's EA”.



2. If you have U.S. EA experience supporting a U.S. CEO, please write “U.S. EA exp” at top of
 (if you don’t, don’t write it).



-If you are fluent in Spanish (not required), please write "Spanish exp" at top of
 (if you don't, don't write it).



-If you have worked in startup/AI or tech space, please write "startup/AI/tech exp" at top of
 (if you don't, don't write it).



-If you have worked in logistics space, please write "logistics exp" at top of
 (if you don't, don't write it).



3. At the bottom of the
, write the USD hourly rate (or salary, but specify hourly, monthly, etc and currency) of your last two roles listed on resume. For example:

-Most recent role: $5/hour (USD-full time)

-2nd most recent role: $6/hour (USD-part time)



**Please note, you earning less or more at previous roles DOES NOT negatively or positively affect your chances of getting this role whatsoever. This is simply information needed for us internally as we try to understand your career path. PLEASE BE HONEST, as this may be officially verified later on in the hiring process.





*Please be very specific in the
, explaining your relevant experience. If you don't follow the above 3-step instructions in how to apply, your application will not be reviewed.

title: Virtual Patient Care Coordinator (Registered Nurse)
description:
U.S. Healthcare Company: Willow Park Health (USA)

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment: Full-Time (Long-Term)

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (U.S.)



About Willow Park Health



We are searching for an exceptional Registered Nurse who wants to build a long-term career with one of the fastest-growing senior behavioral health organizations in New York.Willow Park Health is a rapidly growing U.S. healthcare organization dedicated to improving the lives of seniors.We provide on-site psychiatric and behavioral health services to residents living in assisted living communities throughout New York. Our mission is simple:Helping seniors age with grace, dignity, and purpose.We are building an exceptional team of compassionate professionals who take pride in delivering outstanding service to patients, providers, and healthcare partners.We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Registered Nurse (RN) in the Philippines to serve as a Virtual Patient Care Coordinator.This is a long-term career opportunity—not a temporary VA position.



Who You Are



You are someone who:

Takes ownership and solves problems without waiting to be told

Enjoys organizing people, schedules, and workflows

Communicates professionally and confidently in English

Thrives in a fast-paced healthcare environment

Loves helping patients and supporting healthcare providers

Wants to grow with one company for many years



Your Responsibilities



As our Virtual Patient Care Coordinator, you will play a critical role in ensuring our providers' schedules run efficiently and our patients receive timely care.



Responsibilities include:

Prep notes for providers 

Coordinate psychiatric appointments with assisted living communities

Communicate daily with nurses, wellness directors, and facility staff

Manage provider schedules and maximize daily productivity

Coordinate new patient referrals and follow-up appointments

Maintain accurate patient and resident lists

Answer incoming phone calls,
s, and text messages

Identify scheduling conflicts and resolve issues proactively

Escalate urgent patient or operational concerns appropriately

Support providers with administrative coordination

Assist with additional operational projects as assigned

Please note: This is not a direct patient care position. It is a healthcare coordination and operations role.



Required Qualifications



Active Registered Nurse (RN): prefer US RN certification

Minimum 2 years supporting a U.S. healthcare organization

Experience working with U.S. physicians, nurse practitioners, or medical practices

Excellent spoken and written English

Outstanding phone communication skills

Strong organizational and time management abilities

Comfortable multitasking in a fast-paced environment

Reliable high-speed internet

Quiet, professional home office

Available to work full U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:

Psychiatry or behavioral health

Assisted living communities

Skilled nursing facilities

Long-term care

Patient scheduling

Medical coordination

Insurance verification

Electronic Medical Records (EMRs)



What We Offer



Stable, long-term employment

Monday–Friday schedule (no evenings or weekends)

Paid training

Opportunity for increased compensation based on performance

Professional growth within a rapidly expanding U.S. healthcare company

Supportive leadership team

Meaningful work helping improve the lives of seniors



We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if:

You do not have experience supporting a U.S. healthcare practice

You are seeking freelance or short-term work

You cannot confidently communicate by phone in English

You frequently change jobs

You are applying to dozens of positions without carefully reading this posting



Application Instructions (Read Carefully)



To be considered, you must submit all of the following:

1. Your resume

2. A brief paragraph answering:

Describe your experience supporting a U.S. healthcare practice. Please include the type of practice, your responsibilities, and the EMR systems you have used.

3. A 1–2 minute video introduction (Loom or similar)

Please tell us:

Why you believe you would excel in this role

What makes you different from other applicants

4.
 Subject Line

RN Patient Care Coordinator – [Your Name]

5. Bonus Question

What is one thing you are most proud of accomplishing in your professional career, and why?

title: Creative Analyst
description:
# Meta Ads Creative Analyst



## About the Role



We are looking for a highly analytical Meta Ads Creative Analyst to join our team.



This is NOT a media buyer role and you will NOT be responsible for uploading ads, building campaigns, writing captions, or managing creators. Our tea
mber Daisy handles creator management, ad uploads, campaign setup, and creative implementation.



Your job is to focus on what matters most: identifying winners, spotting losers quickly, analyzing creative performance, and helping us scale winning concepts.



We operate at a high volume and test approximately 500–1,000 creatives per month. We need someone who can review performance daily, make fast decisions, and communicate clearly with our team.



## Responsibilities



* Review Meta ad performance daily

* Analyze creative-level performance across ad sets

* Identify winning creatives and winning creators

* Identify losing creatives that should be paused quickly

* Recommend which creative concepts need more variations

* Recommend which creators should produce more content

* Monitor key performance metrics and trends

* Communicate findings and recommendations in our team chat daily

* Work closely with Daisy to ensure winning concepts are scaled rapidly

* Help build a system for continuously improving creative performance



## What You Will NOT Be Responsible For



* Uploading ads

* Creating campaigns

* Managing budgets

* Writing captions

* Creator outreach

* Editing videos

* Campaign setup



Those responsibilities are already handled by our existing team.



## What We're Looking For



* Strong experience with Meta Ads

* Experience analyzing creative performance at scale

* Ability to identify winning and losing creatives quickly

* Strong understanding of direct response advertising

* Excellent communication skills

* Ability to work independently and make recommendations confidently

* Comfortable reviewing large volumes of creative assets daily



## Success in This Role



A successful candidate will help us:



* Kill losing creatives faster

* Scale winning creatives faster

* Identify winning creators

* Improve creative testing efficiency

* Generate better creative insights for the team



If you enjoy analyzing performance, spotting trends, identifying winners, and helping scale high-volume Meta advertising operations, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Prepress / Artwork QA Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a UK-based signage and vehicle graphics company producing high volumes of artwork for print. Accuracy is critical — mistakes lead to costly reprints, so we are building a dedicated QA process to ensure every file is 100% correct before production.



Role Overview



We are looking for a detail-obsessed QA specialist to check artwork before it goes to print.



This is NOT a creative design role. Your responsibility is to carefully inspect files and ensure they are accurate, correctly scaled, and match the customer brief exactly.



You will be the final checkpoint before production.



Key Responsibilities

Check all artwork against the original job brief before print

Verify measurements and scaling (especially vehicle wheelbase and layout)

Ensure correct use of templates and positioning

Check all text:

spelling

phone numbers

 addresses

URLs

Confirm correct icons, branding, and layout rules are followed

Open and review files in Adobe Illustrator and/or Adobe Acrobat

Ensure files are print-ready (no missing elements, correct setup)

Flag ANY issues clearly before approval

Complete a QA checklist for every job

Important



You must be comfortable saying:



“This job is NOT ready for print”



Accuracy is more important than speed.



Requirements

Strong attention to detail (this is the most important requirement)

Experience in:

print production, signage, OR prepress checking

Ability to read and compare job briefs carefully

Good written English

Comfortable working with measurements and layouts

Experience using Adobe Illustrator and/or Adobe Acrobat

Reliable and consistent

Nice to Have (Not Required)

Experience with vehicle graphics or large format print

Understanding of scale drawings or templates

How to Apply



To apply, you must complete a short test:



We will provide sample artwork files with intentional mistakes.

Your task is to identify ALL errors before print.



This is the most important part of the hiring process.



Why Join Us

Long-term, stable work

Clear systems and processes

Opportunity to grow with the business

Performance-based increases

Working Hours



Flexible, but must overlap with UK working hours for communication when needed.



Pay



Based on experience (part-time to start, with opportunity to increase)



Final Note



We are looking for someone who takes pride in catching mistakes others miss.



If you are highly detail-oriented and enjoy checking work for accuracy, we want to hear from you.

We’re hiring a highly capable, creative, and organized assistant who can help support a business development/marketing leader. You don’t need to be the best writer—but you must be creative and know how to use ChatGPT effectively to draft content and improve messaging.



This is a hybrid role combining Executive Assistant + Social Media/Marketing + Graphic Design support. You will receive direction, examples, and materials—but you must be able to execute quickly, stay organized, and consistently deliver.



Key Responsibilities



Social Media Support (LinkedIn / Instagram / TikTok)

-Create and publish posts using provided materials (content, ideas, direction)

-Repurpose content appropriately per platform (format, tone, posting style)

-Maintain a consistent posting cadence and organized content pipeline



Graphic Design / Marketing Collateral

-Produce clean, professional visuals aligned with brand style

-Outreach & Business Development Support

-Draft outreach messages (ex:
s/messages to therapists, colleges, partners)

-All outreach will start as drafts and be approved before sending

-Keep outreach tracking organized

-Organization & Task Management

-Manage multiple tasks at once without dropping items

-Maintain clear task lists, deadlines, and follow-ups

-Provide regular status updates and show consistent execution



Requirements (Must-Have)

-Excellent English (clear and fluent; no Google Translate dependence)

-Strong ChatGPT skills (you will be using the employer’s ChatGPT account)

-Strong social media familiarity (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok)

-Graphic design skills (Canva required; Adobe is a plus)

-Comfortable handling fast-changing priorities; fast learner

-Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive

-Comfortable communicating via WhatsApp

title: Real Estate Acquisitions - Closer - Land - Remote - USD
description:
ABOUT US



Synergy Land Partners is a growing U.S.-based company that buys vacant land directly from owners across the United States. We're not a giant call center — we're a tight, modern team that values working smart over grinding hard, takes care of its people, and uses the best tools available to make everyone more productive in their role. We're building a company we intend to be a great long-term home.



SLP already has a strong cold outreach team generating a steady, consistent flow of qualified seller leads every week, plus a large backlog of existing leads waiting for the right person. We don't have a shortage of opportunity. We have a need for the right closer to capitalize on it.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Leads come to you already qualified by our outreach team. Your job is to build the relationship and bring the deal home:



• Call pre-qualified seller leads and build genuine rapport and trust with U.S. landowners over the phone

• Evaluate and comp properties using dedicated land software to understand what a parcel is worth and what purchase price meets the company objectives

• Present offers and negotiate purchase agreements using a consultative, two (and often more) call close approach. You're a trusted guide helping sellers make a decision that meets their goals, not a pushy salesperson

• Relentlessly follow up — many of our best deals take weeks or months of patient nurturing before they close. The closer who follows up wins the deal.

• Manage your pipeline in Follow Up Boss with disciplined stages and follow-up cadences

• Own your numbers — track your activity and conversions, and review your pipeline weekly





WHO YOU ARE



• Fluent, natural English — you can hold an easy, confident, rapport-building conversation with a U.S. landowner. This is non-negotiable.

• A proven closer — you know how to handle rejection, work objections, build trust, and ask for the deal over the phone

• Real estate or land experience is a strong plus, but we'll train the right person on land specifics. Sales skill, willingness to learn, and drive matter most.

• Organized and CRM-disciplined — comfortable managing a pipeline (we use Follow Up Boss) without anyone chasing you

• Self-motivated and competitive — you are driven and confident that your consistent hard work will bring results and financial upside for you and the company

• Long-term minded — you want to grow with a company, not fill a six-month gap





WHO THIS IS FOR



• Closers who've crushed it in phone-based sales (real estate, insurance, solar, high-ticket)

• People who want to own their income, not wait for someone to hand it to them

• Self-starters who thrive without constant check-ins

• People hungry for uncapped earning potential who want to grow





WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



• People looking for a "chill" remote job with guaranteed income and low expectations

• People easily discouraged by rejection

• People who can't self-manage their time or pipeline

• People who need constant hand-holding





COMPENSATION



• Base Salary: $1,500/month USD — paid regardless of closings, so you have stability through the longer land sales cycles

• Commission (uncapped): 1% of gross profit on the first $20,000 of gross profit per closed deal, and 2% of gross profit on everything above $20,000. The bigger the deal you negotiate, the more you earn per dollar. (Gross profit = our sale price minus our purchase price. A $20,000-profit deal pays $200; a $40,000-profit deal pays $600.)

• Realistic On-Target Earnings: $2,000–$2,500+/month TOTAL, with real upside as you close more deals and negotiate larger spreads.



This structure is designed to make a serious, capable closer very well rewarded. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this isn't the fit. If you are confident in your ability to close deals, the upside is real.





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please send:



1. A short video recording (2-3 minutes) — introduce yourself and briefly describe your sales/closing experience. For the second half, pretend you're opening a call with a U.S. landowner who owns a vacant parcel and explain how you would approach the first conversation with the lead. Provide the link to your video recording with your application. Applications without a recording will not be considered.



2. Your resume / CV

—



Do you solve problems — not just close tickets?



Apply below for AI-augmented CX work with a fast-scaling global brand.







—



[1] About the Company



This role is hired through Ally, a recruitment and operations partner working with a leading sexual wellness brand.



We are a women-led sexual wellness and intimate health brand, redefining how women experience pleasure, confidence, and comfort. We have grown from zero to 8 figures in annual revenue and are scaling rapidly across the US, UK, EU, and beyond.



Customer experience is central to our mission — especially given the sensitive, deeply personal nature of our category. We approach this with empathy, discretion, and clarity.



We are building a team of problem-solvers and systems thinkers — not ticket machines.



—



[2] The Role



As a Customer Experience Specialist, your role sits at the intersection of support, AI, and operations.



AI handles a large share of first responses. Your job is to step in where complexity begins, ensure quality and accuracy, and identify patterns and fix underlying issues.



You will split your time between:

- Complex support & resolutions (~60–70%)

- QA, reporting, and systems improvement (~30–40%)



You are not just executing — you are improving how the system works.



This role reports to the Head of CX and works alongside a small, high-performance team.



Schedule: This role may require availability to work weekends. Specific shifts will be discussed during the interview process.



—



[3] What You'll Do



Complex Support & Resolutions (~60–70%)

- Handle escalated and nuanced customer issues that require judgment, not scripts

- Manage end-to-end resolution — investigation, decision-making, and follow-through

- Navigate sensitive conversations around sexual wellness with empathy and discretion

- Step in where AI responses fall short or require human context

- Make confident calls in grey areas where policies don't neatly apply

- Escalate with clear thinking and proposed solutions (not just problems)



AI QA, Reporting & Systems (~30–40%)

- Review and quality-check AI-generated responses to ensure accuracy, tone, and correctness

- Identify where AI is failing (logic gaps, tone issues, incorrect resolutions) and improve it

- Build and maintain reporting on ticket trends, product issues, and operational gaps

- Spot patterns (e.g. defective batches, courier failures, confusing UX) and drive root-cause fixes

- Work cross-functionally with ops, product, and marketing to resolve systemic issues

- Create and refine SOPs, macros, and AI workflows



—



[4] What We're Looking For



Must-haves:

- 2+ years of customer service experience (D2C, e-commerce, or consumer-facing roles preferred)

- Strong problem-solving ability — you think in root causes, not surface-level fixes

- Comfortable handling sensitive topics including sexual wellness and intimacy

- High ownership mindset — you take initiative without waiting to be told

- Excellent attention to detail while working at speed

- Experience with tools like Gorgias, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar



Nice-to-haves:

- Experience with Shopify or e-commerce operations

- Comfort working with AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, automation workflows)

- Basic reporting/analysis skills (Google Sheets, Excel, dashboards)

- Experience QA-ing AI outputs or improving automation systems

- Familiarity with tools like Zapier, Make, or internal AI agents

- Cross-functional exposure (ops, logistics, product, marketing)



—



[5] What You'll Get



- USD $850–$1,100 / month (40 hours/week)

- Performance-based growth — compensation tied to impact

- Paid 2-week training and probationary period to get you fully ramped up

- Hands-on experience with AI-first CX systems and workflows

- Fully remote work

- Direct exposure to a fast-scaling global brand (US, UK, EU)

- Ownership of real problems and projects — not just ticket queues

- Opportunity to shape how a modern CX function is built



—



[6] HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application here:

1. Upload your most updated CV

2. Answer a few short questions

3. Record a short Loom (2–3 mins):
