title: Book Warm Leads, Earn $210-$255/wk | US Outbound Appointment Setter | Tue-Sat PT
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

Book warm, exclusive leads for a US licensed sales team. No cold calling. Real bonuses you control. Established operation, working systems, full support from day one.



Every lead you call already raised their hand. They filled out a benefits card, requested information, or are existing clients due for a review. They expect a call from us. Your job is simple: reach them, qualify their interest, and book the Zoom appointment with the right agent.



If you can book appointments, this role pays you for every part of the result. The call. The show. The sale.



EARNINGS BREAKDOWN:

This role pays three ways. Every dollar above base is tied to a specific outcome you control.



1. Base Pay. $3.00/hr × 40 hours = $120/week, paid every Friday via Remitly.

2. Show Bonus. $5.00 for every Qualifying Show (lead joins Zoom for 10+ minutes). Unlocks at a 35% weekly show rate. Average week: 10 shows = $50.

3. Sale Bonus. $10.00 for every Surviving Sale (policy issues and stays in force 30 days). Unlocks at 9 shows per week. Average week: 4 sales = $40.



REALISTIC WEEKLY EARNINGS:

TARGET WEEK — $120 base + $50 show bonus + $40 sale bonus = $210

STRONG WEEK — $120 base + $75 show bonus + $60 sale bonus = $255

TOP PERFORMER — $120 base + $100 show bonus + $80 sale bonus = $300



No hidden caps. No "up to" language. The math is the math. The harder you book, the more you earn.



YOUR WORKDAY:

Tuesday through Saturday, Pacific Time.



Morning block: 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM PT

Break: 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM PT (unpaid, two hours)

Afternoon block: 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM PT



40 hours, every week.



You will call warm leads, send the texts we give you, qualify interest, and book Zoom appointments on our agents' calendars. We provide the phone numbers, the scripts, the leads, the calendar access, and a custom AI assistant built in-house to coach you through objections in real time.



You bring the energy and the dial discipline. We bring everything else.



WHO WE WANT:

You speak clean, confident, US-neutral English.

You have outbound calling experience and you are not afraid of the phone.

You have booked appointments before. Insurance, solar, home services, telecom, real estate, financial services, or B2B all transfer well.

You log your activity without being chased.

You can work Tuesday to Saturday on Pacific Time. Be honest with yourself about this one.

You take direct feedback and apply it immediately.

You do not need to be licensed. You do not sell. You book. Our agents close.

You will need a VPN; however, we will provide the Calling System.



AN ESTABLISHED OPERATION:

We run a focused team. Our agents are licensed, our leads are warm, our systems are built, and our infrastructure is in place. The person who joins us steps into a working operation, not a startup experiment. You get the tools, the training, and the team support to hit your numbers from week one.



HOW TO APPLY:

In your application message, answer these three questions in writing. Short, direct answers are best.



1. What is the highest sustained call volume you have ever hit in a single day? Give the number, the role, and the type of leads.



2. Will you commit to Tuesday through Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM Pacific Time, for at least the next 6 months? Yes or no.



3. A lead picks up and says "I don't remember filling anything out. Take me off your list." You have 15 seconds before they hang up. Write the exact words you would say to keep them on the line.



Applications that skip these questions, give vague answers, or rewrite the questions will not be reviewed.



We are reviewing applications as they arrive and hiring the first qualified setter we connect with. Apply now.

title: Credit Repair Expert Disputer
description:
# Advanced Credit Repair Disputer / Processing Specialist



**Job Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time

**Location:** Remote (Philippines)

**Experience Level:** Experienced / Expert



## About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, aggressive, and highly skilled **Credit Repair Disputer** to join our fast-growing team. This is not a basic dispute role—we need an expert who understands advanced consumer law tactics, aggressive dispute strategies, and how to force deletions across all bureaus and reporting agencies.



Your primary goal is to deliver quick, aggressive turnaround times (30 to 45 days) for our clients while keeping meticulous track of their progress. If you know how to leverage the BBB, CFPB, FTC, and secondary bureaus to get results when basic Metro 2 disputes fail, we want you on our team.



## Key Responsibilities

- **Advanced Disputing:** Draft and submit aggressive, customized disputes to Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- **Secondary Bureau Sweeps:** Execute disputes and freezes with Innovis, LexisNexis, CoreLogic, SageStream, ARS, and other secondary reporting agencies.

- **Regulatory Complaints:** File highly effective complaints with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB), Federal Trade Commission (FTC), and Better Business Bureau (BBB) to force investigations and deletions.

- **Banking & Checking Removals:** Successfully dispute and remove negative records from ChexSystems and Early Warning Services (EWS).

- **Client Tracking & CRM Management:** Meticulously track all client progress, dispute rounds, and correspondence in our CRM to ensure no client falls through the cracks.

- **Aggressive Turnarounds:** Maintain a strict schedule to ensure rapid results, targeting significant deletions within a 30 to 45-day window.



## Requirements & Qualifications

- **Proven Experience:** Minimum 2+ years of experience specifically in advanced credit repair and consumer law disputes (FCRA, FCBA, FDCPA).

- **Expert Knowledge:** Deep understanding of how to bypass e-OSCAR and automated OCR systems using CFPB, BBB, and FTC complaints.

- **Secondary Bureau Mastery:** You must know exactly how to handle Innovis, ChexSystems, and Early Warning Services removals.

- **High Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple client files simultaneously without missing dispute deadlines.

- **Aggressive Mindset:** You don't take "verified" for an answer. You know how to escalate and push back until the item is removed.

- **Tech-Savvy:** Comfortable using credit repair software (e.g., Client Dispute Manager, Credit Repair Cloud) and CRM platforms.



## What We Offer

- Competitive salary based on experience and performance.

- Long-term job stability with a growing company.

- Performance bonuses for fast and consistent deletions.

- A supportive and fast-paced remote work environment.



## How to Apply

If you are the aggressive, results-driven disputer we are looking for, please apply with:

1. A brief summary of your experience with CFPB, BBB, and FTC disputes.

2. Examples of your success with ChexSystems or Early Warning Services.

3. Your expected salary or hourly rate.

4. Put the word "AGGRESSIVE DISPUTER" in the subject line of your application so we know you read this entire post.

title: Affiliate & Editorial Commerce Systems Specialist — One-Time Setup Project ($400–$650)
description:
Affiliate & Editorial Commerce Systems Specialist — One-Time Setup Project ($400–$650)



Job Type: Project-based / Gig (one-time build, **4 weeks maximum**)

Budget: $400–$650 total, paid across 4 milestones (based on experience and scope handled)

Skills: Affiliate Marketing · Google Sheets · WordPress

 applications to: 

Company: Chic Kitty / Shaggy Chic — a pet lifestyle media company







 About this project



We're building a subtle, brand-governed editorial commerce system across a family of premium pet and lifestyle brands. **This is not a spammy affiliate role and not a generic VA role.** The public should feel "here is the world we curate" — never "here is an ad." Internally, we need a clean system for product approval, link tracking, affiliate outreach, content placement, and reporting.



We need a highly organized operator to **build the system once and hand it off** with documentation **within 4 weeks**. There is potential to continue as a part-time maintenance coordinator afterward if the build is excellent — but this posting is for the one-time build.



 How approval works (important)



Your job is to **research candidates, score them against our brand criteria, reject anything off-brand, and bring us a curated shortlist of the right products.** You do not publish or approve products on your own — **you propose, the owner gives final approval.** A product is never approved on commission alone; if it cheapens the brand, it doesn't belong. Brand fit always beats commission.



What you'll build



- A brand-specific product approval database** with scoring (brand fit, visual fit, audience value, quality/trust, content fit — each scored, with reject thresholds)

- An affiliate program tracker** (program, network, application status, commission rate, cookie window, login notes)

- A **link naming + UTM governance system** so no raw links float around

- An outreach CRM** for affiliate applications, partner contacts, sample requests, and follow-ups

- A blog monetization map** matching approved products to upcoming posts and "Approved" resource pages

- A disclosure language library** (blog,
, Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, gifted products, paid partnerships) — FTC-compliant

- A  weekly reporting dashboard** (clicks, sales, commissions, top products, top posts, top platforms)

-SOPs so our team can add monetized links later without breaking the system



4-week milestone plan (approval gate between each)



Milestone plan (4 weeks maximum — finishing sooner is welcome).  

Each milestone must be approved before the next begins; payment is released when each milestone is approved, not on a fixed schedule:



Milestone 1 — Architecture: dashboard structure, brand approval matrix and scoring system, link naming + UTM rules, disclosure fields.  Owner approves the skeleton before research begins.

Milestone 2 — Research + Curated Shortlist: research 100–150 candidates, score each, reject off-brand, organize by brand, and present a curated, scored shortlist to the owner for final approval. The owner picks what's approved.

Milestone 3 — Applications, Outreach + Blog Map: apply to approved programs, build the outreach CRM and templates, map approved products to first posts, draft disclosure blocks.

Milestone 4 — Launch Prep + Handoff: insert first approved links where ready, finalize the reporting dashboard, write the SOPs, and hand off the complete system.



The total project fee is split across the four milestones and released as each is approved.







 What we need from you



- Affiliate marketing research experience — you know how programs, commissions, and cookie windows work

- Strong Google Sheets or Airtable organization

- WordPress familiarity (placement planning, disclosure blocks)

- Excellent English writing and careful attention to detail

- The judgment to evaluate **brand fit, not just commission potential**

- Comfortable working to a fixed 4-week, milestone-gated timeline

- 100% original, human work — no AI-generated content. We screen for this.



Logistics



- One-time project, remote, **4 weeks maximum**

- Reports to the Owner, with Operations Manager acceptance

- Paid by milestone via PayPal or Remitly, released on approval of each milestone

- Potential ongoing part-time maintenance role afterward if the build is excellent



Screening task (include with your application)



Choose **three products** you believe would fit a premium cat or dog lifestyle brand. For each, explain why it's brand-appropriate, genuinely useful to the audience, and monetizable **without feeling salesy.**



We read every application. Generic or AI-written responses won't move forward.

About the role

Cold

Automation (cross-tool)

Reporting

Who you are

Bonus

title: Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home
description:
Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home



Important: Please Read This Full Position Brief Before Applying



We will only consider applicants who read and follow the full instructions in this job description.



If you do not follow the application requirements exactly, your application will not be considered and may be marked as spam.



About the Role

We are hiring a work-from-home Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist.



This is not cold calling. You will be contacting warm leads who have responded to our advertising, usually during the same day or the previous day. These leads have already shown interest and understand that they have made an inquiry.



Your main role is to call as many leads as possible throughout the day, speak with potential clients, and qualify whether they may be eligible for a Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim to be developed by our legal team.



Calls are made through a dial pad inside our CRM. Each tea
mber is provided with their own access so calls can be tracked and monitored.



The Person We Are Looking For

We need someone who is a self-starter, confident on the phone, organised, and able to approach the role with enthusiasm and tenacity.



Success in this role is measured by:



Calls made

Leads qualified

Client sign-ups

Accurate follow-up work

Strong organisation and communication

Exceptional, fluent spoken English is essential. If you are not able to confidently and fluently converse in English, please do not apply.



Additional Admin Responsibilities

Once a client is qualified, there are administrative steps that must be completed. This includes gathering information from the client, sending initial inquiries to insurers and superannuation funds, and staying on top of follow-up tasks.



You will work closely with our Philippines-based admin team and our Sydney-based legal team. You will help make sure matters continue moving through the process, including following up on medical certificates, employment records, insurer information, superannuation fund responses, and other required documents.



There may be times when all leads have been contacted before the end of the day. When that happens, you will be expected to move into admin-related work. Flexibility is very important in this role.



Hours and Working Arrangement

This is a contracted work-from-home role.



Hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Sydney time.



As a contractor, you are responsible for your own equipment, internet connection, local obligations, and working setup in the Philippines.



We are a stable and mature company with strong long-term prospects for remote work. The role includes two weeks of vacation time over Christmas, pro-rated depending on your start date, as well as agreed holiday time.



Tools and Training Provided

We will provide access to:



CRM

Legal CRM

DocuSign

Dialpad

Training to get you up to speed

Strict Application Requirements

To apply, you must
 your application to:







Your
 subject line must be:



Application - Outbound Dialer - [Your Full Name]



Your application must include:



An up-to-date CV

A short covering letter

An original 60-second voice recording reading the script below

The recording must be made specifically for this job application. Do not send an old recording, a generic voice sample, or an AI-generated recording.



Script for Voice Recording

“Hi, my name is [your name], and I’m calling in relation to your recent inquiry about a possible Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim.



I just need to ask you a few quick questions to understand your situation and see whether this may be something our team can assist with.



The call should only take a few minutes. I’ll go through some basic details with you, and if it looks like you may qualify, our team can explain the next steps and what information may be needed.



Is now still a good time to speak?”



Final Note

Applications that do not follow the instructions above will not be considered and may be marked as spam.

title: Legal Admin Clerk / Paralegal Support
description:
Legal Admin Clerk / Paralegal Support | Sydney Legal Business | Work From Home

Please read this job post from top to bottom before applying.



We are only looking for applicants who carefully read the full post and follow the application instructions. If you apply without following the instructions at the bottom, your application will not be considered.



We are a Sydney-based legal business in the personal injury and a
 space, looking for an organised, proactive, and detail-focused Legal Admin Clerk / Paralegal Support tea
mber to join our Philippines-based remote team.



This is a work-from-home, full-time contractor role, working Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time.



About The Role

This is not an outbound sales or dialling role.



Your main responsibility will be to work through a pending list of signed-up potential clients where important information is still outstanding.



These matters cannot move forward properly until the required information has been received, reviewed, and followed up. Your role is to help move these matters from a pending list into active client files that can be allocated to the Sydney legal team.



This means you will be constantly reviewing files, identifying what is missing, following up with the right people or organisations, updating notes, and making sure matters keep progressing.



You may be required to communicate with clients, internal tea
mbers, superannuation funds, insurers, medical clinics, doctors, previous employers, and other relevant third parties to request or follow up on information required for a legal matter.



Key Responsibilities

Your day-to-day work will include:



Reviewing pending client files and identifying outstanding information

Following up with clients and relevant third parties

Liaising with our Philippines-based team who originate the matters

Communicating daily with our Sydney-based legal team

Keeping detailed notes on every file

Updating systems clearly and accurately

Helping move matters from pending status to active legal files

Supporting Sydney-based lawyers with administrative and paralegal-style tasks

Staying organised across multiple matters at the same time

Following up consistently until the required information is received

The key measure of success in this role is your ability to reduce the pending list and keep legal matters moving forward.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organised and detail-focused

A strong written and spoken English communicator

Able to work autonomously from home

A self-starter who can think on their feet

Comfortable following up regularly and professionally

Able to manage a busy workload without losing track of details

Confident speaking on the phone when required

Reliable, consistent, and process-driven

Comfortable working with lawyers, admin teams, and external parties

Able to keep excellent notes and file records

Looking for a long-term role in a structured legal business

This role requires exceptional English and communication skills. You must be able to communicate clearly with Australian-based lawyers, clients, and external organisations.



Technical Requirements

You must have:



A reliable high-speed internet connection

A quiet and professional work-from-home setup

A reliable computer

Confidence using online systems, Slack,
, and cloud-based tools

The ability to demonstrate your internet speed if requested

How The Team Works

You will work closely with our Philippines-based team and our Sydney-based legal team.



The business is managed through Slack channels, internal systems, and structured workflows. You must be comfortable working online, keeping the team updated, and maintaining clear records of your work.



This is a very important role because it helps ensure that legal matters do not sit idle and that clients can move forward through the legal process.



There is real room to grow for the right person.



Compensation And Benefits

We offer:



Attractive compensation for the role

Long-term opportunity with a stable business

Work-from-home arrangement

Supportive team environment

Clear structure, training, and systems

Two weeks paid Christmas vacation, prorated depending on start date

Paid time off over Easter

Major Australian public holidays included

Opportunity to grow within the business

This is a contractor position. You will be responsible for your own tax obligations, government contributions, healthcare, insurance, and any other personal contractor obligations in the Philippines.



Important Application Instructions

To apply, please attach:



Your updated CV

A short cover letter explaining why you are suitable for this role

In your cover letter, please include:



Your legal admin, paralegal, or administrative support experience

Your previous work history and any relevant roles

Why you are highly organised and suited to managing pending files

Why your English and communication skills are strong enough for this role

Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time

Confirmation that you have reliable high-speed internet

Your application subject line must include: TPD Matters Admin



Applications that do not include this in the subject line, or do not attach both a CV and cover letter, will be ignored.



We are looking for people who want a serious, long-term role and who can follow simple instructions carefully.

description:

Most editing jobs are on US time, so you're up until 6 AM, asleep all day while everyone you know is awake. Not here. I'm in Japan, almost the same time zone as you. We work 9 AM to 6 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday. You work in the daytime, eat dinner with your family, and keep your nights.



Read this part before anything else.

I want someone on the way up. If you're into AI, you like playing with it, and you want to get great at AI video and AI marketing, this is for you.



Here's the deal. You don't have to be perfect on day one. You have to care about detail and learn fast. I'll spend real time in your first weeks teaching you everything I've learned making this content. In return I need you to pick it up fast, so we get to the point where you see an instruction and just know what I want and go do it. I'm always here to help, but I'm building editors, not babysitting them.



If you're only here for the paycheck, or you're not into AI, don't apply. If you can't consistently start at 9 AM, don't apply.



THE ROLE

- 4 videos/day

- 5 days/week, 9 AM to 6 PM Philippine time

- Once you're hired I give you scripts, character references, environments, Project Instructions, and paid account access



STACK YOU MUST KNOW

NanoBanana Pro and Veo 3.1 are the main tools. Both run on Google Flow, and this is what you generate with. Higgsfield is fine since it runs NanoBanana Pro and Veo inside it. If you use ChatGPT or Claude as your assistant that's okay, just know I'll switch you to Gemini. CapCut for editing, Google Drive for files.



REQUIREMENTS

Strong English, stable internet and power, a PC that runs CapCut smoothly, a 9 AM start (finish early and you're done, I won't make you sit at your desk until 6 PM unless you want to get ahead), same-day feedback, fast WhatsApp replies, payment via Wise.



PAY

$500 to $600 USD per month depending on experience, paid twice a month via Wise. Monthly bonus for hitting all your daily videos. Pay grows as your output and quality grow.



HOW TO APPLY

The trial is the application. Open the folder at the link below and read the trial brief first. It tells you what to make and how to send it, and everything you need is in that one folder. If you can't be bothered to read it first, don't apply.



The trial is only paid if you get hired, it counts as your first deliverable.



If you didn't do the trial, don't message me. No portfolio, no "I'm interested." No trial link, no reply.

The folder is here:

2 seats. The sooner you send it, the sooner I review it, the sooner I call you, and the sooner I hire.

title: TikTok Short-Form Video Editor - US Food Brand (Street-Interview Style, Ongoing)
description:
We're Counter, a high-protein frozen food brand in the US. Our TikToks are real college students doing street interviews: handing strangers our food and filming their reactions. We're hiring one editor to cut these for the long haul. You get added to our Slack and work straight with us.



HOW IT WORKS



We drop raw footage in a Google Drive folder. You turn it into native 10 to 20 second vertical TikToks. You edit only, no filming. Multiple videos a week.



THE LOOK WE WANT



Go watch SubwayTakes, Grillo's Pickles, and What's Poppin With Davis. Fast and native, like a real person cut it on their phone. Hard jump cuts. Word-by-word captions synced to the talking, sitting low, never over the face. Keep the real audio and reactions up front.



One move we love, the "face freeze": on a funny or grossed-out reaction, freeze the frame, punch-zoom in, and drop ONE sound (a gasp, a record scratch, a vine boom). Once a video, twice at the most.



WHAT GETS A VIDEO REJECTED



- No cha-ching, click, or whoosh sounds on cuts.

- No emojis, stickers, or graphics flying around the screen.

- No glitch or spin transitions, no CapCut "viral template" look, no watermark.



If it looks like a dropshipping ad, it is wrong.



TOOLS



CapCut or Premiere. You fix the auto-captions by hand so brand names are right.



PAY



$10 to $15 per finished video, paid weekly through Wise or Payoneer. Viral bonus on top when one of your edits hits big views in its first week. Honest heads up: this is a brand new program, so the first few weeks will be a little bumpy while we dial it in together.



HOW TO APPLY (we skip anyone who skips this)



1. Start your reply with the word FREEZE so we know you read this.

2. Send 2 or 3 links to short vertical videos you edited, street-interview or reaction style. One line each on what you did.

3. Tell us one thing you would never add to a video like ours.



Strong applicants get a PAID test edit on real footage we already shot.

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

 Average video length: 10–15 minutes

 Full script

All final animations and assets created for the channel belong to BattlePaws



Recruitment & filtering process: 



Step 1 — Initial Application Filter



Applicants are first filtered based on:



 Portfolio quality

 Communication

 Responsiveness

 Compatibility with the channel style

This first pass is mainly used to remove low-effort or incompatible applicants and is not heavily scored.



Required in your application (in this order):



1. Start with the word: Legion

6. Your time zone (so we know if we can sync via WhatsApp)

Applications that don't include all six items above, or that don't start with "Legion," will be ignored.



Step 2 — Paid Animation Test

Selected applicants from Step 1 will be invited to a paid animation test.

The test materials are hosted in this read-only Google Drive folder:







Inside you'll find:



 The full brief (READ FIRST/)

 3 scenes of script + voice-over + storyboard images (References/, Storyboards/, Voice Over/)

 A preview MP4 showing scene-change timing

 Channel style references and mascot turntable

The storyboard is creative guidance, not strict frame-by-frame instructions. Creative improvements are welcome if they fit the channel style.



The test evaluates:



 Pacing

 Comedic timing

 Visual clarity

 Ability to follow instructions

 Communication

 Workflow organization

 Overall YouTube retention quality



Technical requirements: 



 Resolution: 1920 × 1080

 Frame rate: 30 fps

 Export format: MP4 (H.264)



Required deliverables:



 Final MP4 export

 Project files

 Assets used during production



Time & deadline: 



 Approximately 4–6 hours of work expected

How to submit:



When finished, upload your deliverables (MP4, project files, assets) to your own Google Drive folder set to view-only, then submit the link via our submission form:







The form takes ~1 minute to fill out. Do not
 files directly — the form is the only submission channel.



Step 3 — Final Selection :

The later stages of recruitment become much more selective. The final decision is based on:

 Reliability

 Communication

 Speed

 Consistency

 Ability to work long-term within the BattlePaws production pipeline



If you're officially selected after the test phase, you receive a $75 USD bonus alongside your first project's compensation.

Payment structure
